vikīrṇā parvatais taiś ca drumachinnaiś ca ca saṃyugē hataiś ca kapirakṣōbhir durgamā vasudhābhavat ।।
tatō hayaṃ mārutatulyavēgam āruhya śaktiṃ niśitāṃ pragṛhya . narāntakō vānarasainyam ugraṃ mahārṇavaṃ mīna ivāvivēśa ।।
dadṛśuś ca mahātmānaṃ hayapṛṣṭhē pratiṣṭhitam . carantaṃ harisainyēṣu vidyādharamaharṣayaḥ ।।
dadāha harisainyāni vanānīva vibhāvasuḥ . yāvad utpāṭayāmāsur vṛkṣān śailān vanaukasaḥ ।।
tāvat prāsahatāḥ pētur vajrakṛttā ivācalāḥ jvalantam prāsam udyamya saṅgrāmāntē narāntakaḥ ।।
ēkēnāntakakalpēna prāsēnādityatējasā . bhagnāni harisainyāni nipētur dharaṇītalē ।।
prēkṣamāṇaḥ sa sugrīvō dadarśe harivāhinīm . narāntakabhayatrastāṃ vidravantīm yatas tataḥ ।।
gacchenaṃ rākṣasaṃ vīraṃ yō’sau turagamāsthitaḥ . bhakṣayantaṃ parabalaṃ kṣipraṃ prāṇair viyōjaya ।।
nirāyudhō mahātējāḥ kēvalaṃ nakhadaṃṣṭravān . narāntakam abhikramya vāliputrō ‘bravīd vacaḥ ।।
sa prāsam āvidhya tadāṅgadāya samujjvalantaṃ sahasōtsasarja . sa vāliputrōrasi vajrakalpē babhūva bhagnō nyapatac ca bhūmau ।।
nimagnapādaḥ sphuṭitākṣitārō niṣkrāntajihvō ‘calasaṃnikāśaḥ . sa tasya vājī nipapāta bhūmau talaprahārēṇa vikīrṇamūrdhā ।।
athāṅgadō mṛtyusamānavēgaṃ saṃvartya muṣṭiṃ giriśṛṅgakalpam . nipātayāmāsa tadā mahātmā narāntakasyōrasi vāliputraḥ ।।
sa muṣṭinirbhinnanimagnavakṣā jvālā vamañ śōṇitadigdhagātraḥ . narāntakō bhūmitalē papāta yathācalō vajranipātabhagnaḥ ।।
tadāntarikṣē tridaśōttamānāṃ vanaukasāṃ caiva mahāpraṇādaḥ . babhūva tasmin nihatē ‘gryavīryē narāntakē vālisutēna saṃkhyē ।।
ārūḍhō mēghasaṅkāśaṃ vāraṇēndraṃ mahōdaraḥ . vāliputraṃ mahāvīryam abhidudrāva vīryavān ।।
ratham ādityasaṃkāśaṃ yuktaṃ paramavājibhiḥ . āsthāya triśirā vīrō vāliputram athābhyagāt ।।
sa tribhir dēvadarpaghnai rakṣasendrair abhidrutaḥ . vṛkṣam utpāṭayāmāsa mahāviṭapam aṅgadaḥ ।।
dēvāntakāya taṃ vīraś cikṣēpa sahasāṅgadaḥ . mahāvṛkṣaṃ mahāśākhaṃ śakrō dīptam ivāśanim ।।
gajēna samabhidrutya vāliputraṃ mahōdaraḥ . jaghānōrasi saṃkruddhas tōmarair vajrasaṃnibhaiḥ ।।
dēvāntakaś ca saṃkruddhaḥ parighēṇa tadāṅgadam . upagamyābhihatyāśu vyapacakrāma vēgavān ।।
sa tribhir nairṛtaśrēṣṭhair yugatapat samabhidrutaḥ . na vivyathē mahātējā vāliputraḥ pratāpavān ।।
pētatur nayanē tasya vinanāśa sa kuñjaraḥ viṣāṇaṃ cāsya niṣkṛṣya vāliputrō mahābalaḥ ।।
dēvāntakam abhiplutya tāḍayām āsa saṃyugē sa vihvalas tu tējasvī vātōddhūta iva drumaḥ ।।
lakṣārasasavarṇaṃ ca susrāva rudhiraṃ mahat athāśvasya mahātējāḥ kṛcchrād dēvāntakō balī ।।
āvidhya parighaṃ vēgād ājaghāna tadāṅgadam parighābhihataś cāpi vānarēndrātmajas tadā ।।
jānubhyāṃ patitō būmau punar ēvōtpapāta ha tam utpatantaṃ triśirās tribhir bāṇair ajihmagaiḥ ।।
ghōrair haripatēḥ putraṃ lalāṭē ‘bhijaghāna ha tatō ‘ṅgadaṃ parikṣiptaṃ tribhir nairṛtapuṃgavaiḥ ।।
hanūmān atha vijñāya nīlaś cāpi pratasthatuḥ tataś cikṣēpa śailāgraṃ nīlas triśirasē tadā ।।
tad rāvaṇasutō dhīmān bibhēda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ tad bāṇaśatanirbhinnaṃ vidāritaśilātalam ।।
savisphuliṅgaṃ sajvālaṃ nipapāta girēḥ śiraḥ sa vijṛmbhitam ālōkya harṣād dēvāntako balī ।।
parighēṇābhidudrāva mārutātmajam āhavē tam āpatantam utpatya hanumān kapikuñjaraḥ ।।
ājaghāna tadā mūrdhni vajrakalpēna muṣṭinā śirasi prāharad vīras tadā vāyusutō balī . nādēnā kampayac caiva rākṣasān sa mahākapiḥ ।।
sa muṣṭiniṣpiṣṭavibhinnamūrdhā nirvāntadantākṣivilambijihvaḥ . dēvāntakō rākṣasarājasūnur gatāsur urvyāṃ sahasā papāta ।।
tasmin hatē rākṣasayōdhamukhyē mahābalē saṃyati dēvaśatrau . kruddhas triśīrṣo niśitāstram ugraṃ vavarṣa nīlōrasi bāṇavarṣam ।।
mahōdaras tu saṃkruddhaḥ kuñjaraṃ parvatōpamam . bhūyas samadhiruhyāśu mandaraṃ raśmivān iva ।।
tataḥ śaraughair abhivrṣyamāṇō vibhinnagātraḥ kapisainyapālaḥ . nīlō babhūvātha visṛṣṭagātrō viṣṭambhitas tēna mahābalēna ।।
tataḥ sa śailābhinipātabhagnō mahōdaras tēna mahādvipēna . vyāmōhitō bhūmitalē gatāsuḥ papāta vajrābhihatō yathādriḥ ।।
atha śaktiṃ samādāya kālarātrim ivāntakaḥ . cikṣēpānilaputrāya triśirā rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।।
khaḍgaprahārābhihatō hanumān mārutātmajaḥ . ājaghāna trimūrdhānaṃ talēnōrasi vīryavān ।।
sa talābhihatas tēna srastahastāmbarō bhuvi . nipapāta mahātējās triśirās tyaktacētanaḥ ।।
sa tasya patataḥ khaḍgaṃ tam ācchidya mahākapiḥ . nanāda girisaṃkāśas trāsayan sarvarākṣasān ।।
tēna muṣṭiprahārēṇa saṃcukōpa mahākapiḥ . kupitaś ca nijagrāha kirīṭē rākṣasarṣabham ।।
tāny āyatākṣāṇy agasaṃnibhāni pradīptavaiśvānaralōcanāni . pētuḥ śirāṃsīndraripōḥ pṛthivyaṃ jyōtīṃṣi muktāni yathendramārgāt ।।
tasmin hate dēvaripau triśīrṣē hanūmatā śakraparākramēṇa . nēduḥ plavaṅgāḥ pracacāla bhūmī rakṣāṃsy athō dudruvirē samantāt ।।
hataṃ triśirasaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhonmattaṃ tathaiva ca hatau prēkṣya durādharṣau dēvāntakanarāntakau ।।
cukōpa paramāmarṣī mattō rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ jagrāhārciṣmatīṃ cāpi gadāṃ sarvāyasīṃ śubhāṃ ।।
hēmapaṭṭaparikṣiptāṃ māṃsaśōṇitaphēnilām . virājamānāṃ vipulāṃ śatruśōṇitatarpitām ।।
tējasā saṃpradīptāgrāṃ raktamālyavibhūṣitām . airāvatamahāpadmasārvabhaumabhayāvahām ।।
atha rṣabhaḥ samutpatya vānarō rāvaṇānujam . mattānīkam upāgamya tasthau tasyāgratō balī ।।
muhūrtam āsīt sa gatāsukalpaḥ pratyāgatātmā sahasā surāriḥ . utpatya saṃdhyābhrasamānavarṇas taṃ vārirājātmajam ājaghāna ।।
mattānīkaṃ mahātmā sa jaghāna raṇamūrdhani . sa svayā gadayā bhagnō vidīrṇadaśanēkṣaṇaḥ ।।
svabalaṃ vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tumulaṃ rōmaharṣaṇam . bhrātṛṃś ca nihatān dṛṣṭvā śakratulyaparākramān ।।
cukōpa ca mahātējā brahmadattavarō yudhi . atikāyō ‘drisaṃkāśō dēvadānavadarpahā ।।
tē tasya rūpam ālōkya yathā viṣṇōs trivikramē . bhayād vānarayodhās tē vidravanti tatas tataḥ ।।
kālajihvāprakāśābhir ya ēṣō ‘bhivirājatē . āvṛtō rathaśaktībhir vidyudbhir iva tōyadaḥ ।।
dhvajaśṛṅgapratiṣṭhēna rāhuṇābhivirājatē . sūryaraśmiprabhair bāṇair diśō daśa virājayan ।।
triṇataṃ mēghanirhādaṃ hēmapṛṣṭham alaṅkṛtam . śatakratudhanuḥprakhyaṃ dhanuś cāsya virājatē ।।
kāñcanāṅgadanaddhābhyāṃ bhūjābhyām ēṣa śōbatē . śṛṅgābhyām iva tuṅgābhyāṃ himavān parvatōttamaḥ ।।
kuṇḍalābhyām ubhābhyām ca bhāti vaktraṃ subhīṣaṇam. punarvasvantaragataṃ paripūrṇo niśākaraḥ ।।
surāsurair avadhyatvaṃ dattam asmai svayambhuvā . ētac ca kavacaṃ divyaṃ rathaś ca ravibhāsvaraḥ ।।
vajraṃ viṣṭambhitaṃ yēna bāṇair indrasya dhīmatā . pāśaḥ salilarājasya yuddhe pratihatas tathā ।।
ēṣō ‘tikāyō balavān rākṣasānām atha rṣabhaḥ . sa rāvaṇasutō dhīmān dēvadānavadarpahā ।।
tēṣāṃ vṛkṣāṃś ca śailāṃś ca śaraiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ . atikāyō mahātējāś cicchēdāstravidāṃ varaḥ ।।
tāṃś caiva sarvān sa harīn śaraiḥ sarvāyasair balī vivyāthābhimukhān saṃkhyē bhīmakāyō viśāradaḥ ।।
tē ’rditā bāṇavarṣēṇa bhinnagātrāḥ parājitāḥ . na śēkur atikāyasya pratikartuṃ mahāhave ।।
kruddhaḥ saumitrir utpatya tūṇād ākṣipya sāyakam . purastād atikāyasya vicakarṣa mahad dhanuḥ ।।
pūrayan sa mahīṃ sarvām ākāśaṃ sāgaraṃ diśaḥ . jyāśabdō lakṣmaṇasyōgras trāsayan rajanīcarān ।।
na hi madbāhusṛṣṭānām bāṇānāṃ himavān api sōḍhum utsahatē vēgam antarikṣam athō mahī ।।
tatō vidyādharā bhūtā devadaityā maharṣayaḥ guhyakāś ca mahātmānas tad yuddhaṃ dadṛśus tadā ।।
tatō ‘tikāyaḥ kupitaś cāpam ārōpya sāyakam lakṣmaṇāya pracikṣēpa saṃkṣipann iva cāmbaram ।।
tāñ śarān sampracikṣēpa lakṣmaṇāya niśācaraḥ tān aprāptāñ śitair bānaiś cicchēda bharatānujaḥ ।।
sādhu bāṇanipātēna ślāghanīyō ‘si mē ripuḥ vidhāyaivaṃ vidāryāsyaṃ vinamya ca mahābhujau sa rathōpastham āsthāya rathēna pracacāra ha ।।
tas tān rākṣasōtsṛṣṭāñ śaraughān rāghavānujaḥ asambrāntaḥ pracicchēda niśitair bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
tāv ubhāv ambarē bāṇāv anyōnyam abhijaghnatuḥ tējasā saṃpradīptāgrau kruddhāv iva bhujaṃgamau tāv anyōnyaṃ vinirdahya pētatur pṛvthivītalē ।।
tatō ‘tikāyaḥ saṃkruddhas tv aṣṭram aiṣīkam utsṛjat . tataś cicchēda saumitrir astram aindrēṇa vīryavān ।।
muhūrtamātraṃ niḥsaṃjñō hy abhavac chatrutāpanaḥ tataḥ saṃjñām upālabhya caturbhiḥ sāyakōttamaiḥ ।।
tatas tu vāyōr vacanaṃ niśamya saumitrir indrapratimānavīryaḥ . samādadhē bāṇam athōgravēgaṃ tad brāhmamastraṃ sahasā niyōjya ।।
praharṣayuktā bahavas tu vānarāḥ praphullapadmapratimānanās tadā . apūjayaṃl lakṣmaṇam iṣṭabhāginaṃ hatē ripau bhīmabalē durāsadē ।।
dhūmrākṣaḥ paramāmarṣī sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ . akampanaḥ prahastaś ca kumbhukarṇas tathaiva ca ।।
ētē mahābalā vīrā rākṣasā yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ jētāraḥ parasainyānāṃ parair nityāparājitāḥ ।।
sasainyās te hatā vīrā rāmēṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā . rākṣasāḥ sumahākāyā nānāśastraviśāradāḥ ।।
anyē ca bahavaḥ śūrā mahātmānō nipātitāḥ prakhyātabalavīryēṇa putrēṇēndrajitā mama ।।
tau bhrātarau tadā baddhau ghorair dattavaraiḥ śaraiḥ yan na śakyaṃ suraiḥ sarvair asurair vā mahābalaiḥ ।।
tatō hatān rākṣasapuṃgavāṃs tān dēvāntakāditriśirō ‘tikāyān . rakṣōgaṇās tatra hatāvaśiṣṭās tē rāvaṇāya tvaritāḥ śaśaṃsuḥ ।।
tatas tu rājānam udīkṣya dīnaṃ śōkārṇavē saṃparipupluvānam . ratharṣabhō rākṣasarājasūnus tam indrajid vākyam idaṃ babhāṣē ।।
na tāta mōhaṃ parigantum arhase yatrēndrajjīvati nairṛteśa . nēndrāribāṇābhihatō hi kaścit prāṇān samarthaḥ samarē ‘bhipātum ।।
adyēndravaivasvataviṣṇurudrasādhyāś ca vaiśvānaracandrasūryāḥ . drakṣyantu mē vikramam apramēyaṃ viṣṇōr ivōgraṃ baliyajñavāṭē ।।
taṃ prasthitaṃ mahātmānam anujagmur mahābalāḥ . samharṣamāṇā bahavō dhanuḥpravarapāṇayaḥ ।।
gajaskandhagatāḥ kēcit kēcit paramavājibhiḥ vyāghravṛścikamārjārakharōrōṣṭraiś ca bhujaṅgamaiḥ ।।
varāhaiḥ śvāpadaiḥ siṃhair jambukaiḥ parvatōpamaiḥ . kākahaṃsamayūraiś ca rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ prāsamudgaranistriṃśaparaśvadhagadādharāḥ bhṛśuṇḍimudgarāyaṣṭiśataghnīparighāyudhā ।।
sa śaṅkhaninadaiḥ pūrṇair bhērīṇāṃ cāpi niḥsvanaiḥ . jagāma tridaśēndrārir ājiṃ vegena vīryavān ।।

[sa tu dṛṣṭvā viniryāntaṃ balēna mahātā vṛtam . rākṣasādhipatiḥ śrīmān rāvaṇaḥ putram abravīt ।। tvam apratirathaḥ putra tvayā vai vāsavō jitaḥ . kim punar mānuṣaṃ dhṛṣyaṃ nihaniṣyasi rāghavam ।। tathōktō rākṣasēndrēṇa pratyagṛhṇān mahāśiṣaḥ] tatas tv indrajitā laṅkā sūryapratimatējasā rarājāprativīryēṇa dyaur ivārkēṇa bhāsvatā ।।
pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhas taptakāñcanasaṃnibhaḥ havis tat pratijagrāha pāvakaḥ svayamutthitaḥ ।।
sō ‘stram āhārayāmāsa brāhmam astraviśāradaḥ dhanuś cātmarathaṃ caiva sarvaṃ tatrābhyamantrayat ।।
tē śarair bahubhiś citrais tīkṣṇavēgair alaṅkṛtaiḥ . tōmarair aṅkuśaiś cāpi vānarān jaghnur āhavē ।।
rāmasyārthē parākramya vānarās tyaktajīvitāḥ . nardantas tē ‘nivṛttās tu samarē saśilāyudhāḥ ।।
ghōrair dattavarais tīkṣṇair niṣprāṇān akarōt tadā anyān api tadā mukhyān vānarān bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
ardayāmāsa saṃkruddhaḥ kālānagir iva mūrchitaḥ sa śaraiḥ sūryasaṃkāśaiḥ sumuktaiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ ।।
vānarāṇām anīkāni nirmamantha mahāraṇē ākulāṃ vānarīṃ sēnāṃ śarajālēna mōhitām ।।
udīkṣamāṇā gaganaṃ kēcin nētrēṣu tāḍitāḥ . śarair viviśur anyōnyaṃ pētuś ca jagatītalē ।।
hanūmantaṃ ca sugrīvam aṅgadaṃ gandhamādanam . jāmbavantaṃ suṣēṇaṃ ca vēgadarśinam ēva ca ।।
sūryānanaṃ jyōtimukhaṃ tathā dadhimukhaṃ harim . pāvakākṣaṃ nalaṃ caiva kumudaṃ caiva vānaram ।।
prasaiḥ śūlaiḥ śitair bāṇair indrajin mantrasaṃhitaiḥ . vivyādha hariśārdūlān sarvāṃs tān rākṣasōttamaḥ ।।
sa bāṇavarṣair abhivṛṣyamāṇō dhārānipātān iva tān acintya . samīkṣamāṇaḥ paramādbhutaśrī rāmas tato lakṣmaṇam ity uvāca ।।
asau punar lakṣmaṇa rākṣasēndrō mahāstram āśritya surēndraśatruḥ . nipātayitvā harisainyam ugram asmāñ śitaiḥ śarair ardayati prasaktam ।।
mā bhaiṣṭa nāsty atra viṣādakālō yadāryaputrau hy avaśau viṣaṇṇau . svayambhuvō vākyam athōdvahantau yat sāditāv indrajidastrajālaiḥ ।।
brāhmam astraṃ tatō dhīmān mānayitvā tu mārutiḥ . vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hanūmān idam abravīt ।।
patitaiḥ parvatākārair vānarair abhisaṃvṛtām . śastraiś ca patitair dīptair dadṛśātē vasundharām ।।
maindaṃ nalaṃ jyōtimukhaṃ dvividaṃ cāpi vānaram . vibhīṣaṇō hanūmāṃś ca dadṛśātē hatān raṇē ।।
dṛṣṭvā samabhisaṃkramya paulastyō vākyam abravīt kaścid ārya śarais tīkṣṇair na prāṇā dhvaṃsitās tava ।।
vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā jāmbavān ṛkṣapuṃgavaḥ . kṛcchrād abhyudgiran vākyam idaṃ vacanam abravīt ।।
nairṛtēndra mahāvīrya svarēṇa tvābhilakṣayē . viddhagātraiḥ śitair bāṇair na tvāṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā ।।
asmiñ jīvati vīrē tu hatam apy ahataṃ balam . hanūmaty ujjhitaprāṇē jīvantō ‘pi mṛtā vayam ।।
śrutvā hanumatō vākyaṃ tadā vivyathitēndriyaḥ . punar jātam ivātmānaṃ manyatē plavagōttamaḥ ।।
tataḥ kāñcanam atyugramṛṣabhaṃ parvatōttamam . kailāsaśikharaṃ cātra drakṣyasy ariniṣūdana ।।
tayōḥ śikharayōr madhyē pradīptam atulaprabham . sarvauṣadhiyutaṃ vīra drakṣyasyoṣadhiparvatam ।।
tāḥ sarvā hanuman gṛhya kṣipram āgantum arhasi . āśvāsaya harīn prāṇair yōjya gandhavahātmaja ।।
[ārurōha tadā tasmād dharir malayaparvatam . mērumandarasaṃkāśaṃ nānāprasravaṇākulam ।।
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ vikāsikamalōtpalam . sēvitaṃ dēvagandharvaiḥ ṣaṣṭiyōjanam ucchritam ।।
vidyādharair munigaṇair apsarōbhir niṣēvitam . nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ bahukandaraśōbhitam ।।
sarvān ākulayaṃs tatra yakṣagandharvakinnarān . hanumān mēghasaṃkāśō vavṛdhē mārutātmajaḥ ।।
sa parvatān pakṣiganān sarāṃsi nadīs taṭākāni purōttamāni . sphītān janāṃs tān api sampravīkṣya jagāma vēgāt pitṛtulyavēgaḥ ।।
kailāsam agraṃ himavacchilāṃ ca taṃ vai vṛṣaṃ kāñcanaśailam agryam . pradīptasarvauṣadhisaṃpradīptaṃ dadarśa sarvauṣadhiparvatēndram ।।
mahauṣadhyas tu tāḥ sarvās tasmin parvatasattame vijñāyārthinam āyāntaṃ tato jagmur adarśanam ||
sa tā mahātmā hanumān apaśyaṃś cukopa roṣāc ca bhṛśaṃ nanāda amṛṣyamāṇo 'gnisamānacakṣur mahīdharendraṃ tam uvāca vākyam ||
tāv apy ubhau mānuṣarājaputrau taṃ gandham āghrāya mahauṣadhīnām . babhūvatus tatra tadā viśalyāv uttasthur anyē ca haripravīrāḥ ।।
yadā prabhṛti laṅkāyāṃ yudhyantē harirākṣasāḥ . tadā prabhṛti mānārtham ājñayā rāvaṇasya ca ।।
tatō harir gandhavahātmajas tu tam ōṣadhīśailam udagravēgaḥ . nināya vēgād dhimavantam ēva punaś ca rāmēṇa samājagāma ।।
tatō ‘bravīn mahātējāḥ sugrīvō vānareśvaraḥ . arthyaṃ vijñāpayaṃś cāpi hanūmantam idaṃ vacaḥ ।।
[harayō harisaṃkāśāḥ pradagdhuṃ rāvaṇālayam] tatō’staṃ gata ādityē raudrē tasmin niśāmukhē laṅkām abhimukhāḥ sōlkā jagmus tē plavagarṣabhāḥ ।।
nānāvikṛtasaṃsthānaṃ vājibhāṇḍaparicchadam gajagraivēyakakṣyāś ca rathabhāṇḍāś ca samskṛtān ।।
vividhān astrasaṃghātān agnir dahati tatra vai nānāvidhān gṛhāṃś citrān dadāha hutabhuk tadā ।।
āvāsān rākṣasānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gṛhagṛdhnunām hemacitratanutrāṇāṃ sragbhāṇḍāmbaradhāriṇām || R_6,062.
sīdhupānacalākṣāṇāṃ madavihvalagāminām kāntālambitavastrāṇāṃ śatrusaṃjātamanyunām R_6,062.
gadāśūlāsihastānāṃ khādatāṃ pibatām api śayaneṣu mahārheṣu prasuptānāṃ priyaiḥ saha R_6,062.
trastānāṃ gacchatāṃ tūrṇaṃ putrān ādāya sarvataḥ teṣāṃ śatasahasrāṇi tadā laṅkānivāsinām R_6,062.
adahat pāvakas tatra jajvāla ca punaḥ punaḥ sāravanti mahārhāṇi gambhīraguṇavanti ca R_6,062.
hemacandrārdhacandrāṇi candraśālottamāṇi ca tatra citragavākṣāṇi sādhiṣṭhānāni sarvaśaḥ R_6,062.
maṇividrumacitrāṇi spṛśantīva divākaram krauñcabarhiṇavīṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ R_6,062.
nāditāny acalābhāni veśmāny agnir dadāha saḥ jvalanēna parītāni tōraṇāni cakāśirē ।।
tyaktābharaṇasaṃyogā hāhēty uccair vicukruśuḥ tatra cāgniparītāni nipētur bhavanāny api ।।
himavacchikharāṇīva dahyamānāni sarvaśaḥ harmyāgrair dahyamānaiś ca jvālāprajvalitair api ।।
rātrai sādṛśyatē laṅkā puṣpitair iva kiṅśukaiḥ hastyadhyakṣair gajair muktair muksaiś caiva turagair api babhūva laṅkā lōkāntē bhrāntagrāha ivārṇavaḥ ।।
pradagdhakāyān aparān rākṣasān nirgatān bahiḥ . sahasā hy utpatanti sma harayō ‘tha yuyutsavaḥ ।।
tasya kārmukanirmuktaiḥ śarais tat puragōpuram . kailāsaśṛṅgapratimaṃ vikīrṇam abhavad bhuvi ।।
ādiṣṭā vānarēndrās tē sugrīvēṇa mahātmanā . āsannaṃ dvāram āsādya yudhyadhvaṃ plavagarṣabhāḥ ।।
yaś ca vō vitathaṃ kurvāt tatra tatra apy upasthitaḥ . sa hantavyō ‘bhisaṃplutya rājaśāsanadūṣakaḥ ।।
rakṣasāṃ bhūṣaṇasthābhir bhābhiḥ svābhiś ca sarvaśaḥ . cakrus tē saprabhaṃ vyōma harayaś cāgnibhiḥ saha ।।
patākādhvajasaṃyuktam uttamāsiparaśvadham . bhīmāśvarathamātaṅgaṃ nānāpattisamākulam ।।
dīptaśūlagadākhaḍagaprāsatōmarakārmukam . tad rākṣasabalaṃ bhīmaṃ ghōravikramapauruṣam ।।
vyāghūrṇitamahāśastraṃ bāṇasaṃsaktakārmukam . gandhamālyamadhūtsēkasaṃmōditamahānilam ।।
ghōraṃ śūrajanākīrṇaṃ mahāmbudharaniḥsvanam . tad dṛṣṭvā balam āyātaṃ rākṣasānāṃ sudāruṇaṃ ।।
saṃcacāla plavaṅgānāṃ balam uccair nanāda ca javēnāphlutya ca punas tad balaṃ rakṣasāṃ mahat ।।
abhyayāt pratyaribalaṃ pataṅgā iva pāvakam tēṣāṃ bhujaparāmarśavyāmṛṣṭaparighāśani ।।
rākṣasānāṃ balaṃ śrēṣṭhaṃ bhūyaḥ param aśōbhata tatrōnmattā ivōtpētur harayō ‘tha yuyutsavaḥ ।।
taruśailair abhighnantō muṣṭibhiś ca niśācarān tathaivāpatatāṃ tēṣāṃ kapīnām niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
śirāṃsi sahasā jahrū rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ daśanair hatakarṇāś ca muṣṭibhir bhinnamastakāḥ śilāprahārabhagnāṅgā vicērus tatra rākṣasāḥ ।।
tathaivāpy aparē tēṣāṃ kapīnām asibhiḥ śitaiḥ pravarān abhitō jaghnur ghōrarūpā niśācarāḥ ।।
ghnantam anyaṃ jaghānānyaḥ pātayantam apātayat garhamāṇaṃ jagarhānyō daśantam aparō ‘daśat ।।
vipralambhitaśastraṃ ca vimuktakavacāyudham samudyatamahāprāsaṃ yaṣṭiśūlāsikuntalam ।।
rākṣasān daśa saptēti vānarāś cābhyapātayan vipralambhitavastraṃ ca vimuktakavacadhvajam . balaṃ rākṣasam ālambya vānarāḥ paryavārayan ।।
sō’ṅgadaṃ niśitair bāṇais tadā vivyādha vēgitaḥ . śarīradāraṇais tīkṣṇaiḥ kālāgnisamavigrahaiḥ ।।
kṣurakṣurapranārācair vatsadantaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ . karṇiśalyavipāṭhaiś ca bahubhir niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।।
tasyāṃ sa phalakē khaḍgaṃ nijaghāna tatō ‘ṅgadaḥ . yajñōpavītavac cainaṃ cicchēda kapikuñjaraḥ ।।
trayāṇāṃ vānarēndrāṇāṃ tribhī rākṣasapuṃgavaiḥ . saṃsaktānāṃ mahad yuddham abhavad rōmaharṣaṇam ।।
rathān aśvān drumān cchailān praticikṣipur āhavē . śaraughaiḥ praticicchēda tān yūpākṣō mahābalaḥ ।।
etasminn antarē maindō vīrō dvividābhyāśam āgataḥ yūpākṣaṃ tāḍayāmāsa talēnōrasi vīryavān tau śōṇitākṣyūpākṣau plavaṅgābhyāṃ tarasvinau . cakratuḥ samarē tīvram ākarṣōtpāṭanaṃ bhṛśam ।।
āpatatantīṃ ca vēgēna kumbhas tāṃ sāntvayac camūm . athōtkṛṣṭaṃ mahāvīryair labdhalakṣaiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ ।।
sahasābhihatas tēna vipramuktapadaḥ sphuran . nipapāta trikūṭābhō vihvalan plavagōttamaḥ ।।
tam āpatantaṃ vivyādha kumbhaḥ pañcabhir āyasaiḥ . tribhiś cānyais śitair bāṇair mātaṅgam iva tōmaraiḥ sō ‘ṅgadaṃ bahubhir bāṇaiḥ kumbhō vivyādha vīryavān ।।
akuṇṭhadhārair niśitais tīkṣṇaiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ aṅgadaḥ prativiṣṭāṅgō vāliputra na kampatē ।।
aṅgadaḥ pāṇinā nētrē pidhāya rudhirōkṣitē sālam āsannam ēkēna parijagrāha pāṇinā ।।
sampīḍyorasi sskandham karēṇābhinivēśya ca kiṃcid abhyavanamyainam unmamātha mahoraṇe ।।
sa cichēda śitair bāṇaiḥ saptabhiḥ kāyabhēdanaiḥ ।।
aṅgadō vivyathē ‘bhīkṣṇaṃ sa papāta mumōha ca aṅgadaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sīdantam iva sāgaram durāsadaṃ hariśrēṣṭhaṃ rāghavāya nyavēdayan ।।
jāmbavāṃś ca suṣēṇaś ca vēgadarśī ca vānaraḥ kumbhakarṇātmajaṃ vīraṃ kruddhāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ ।।
tāṃs tu dṛṣṭvā harigaṇān śaravṛṣṭibhir arditān aṅgadaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā bhrātṛjaṃ plavagēśvaraḥ ।।
abhidudrāva sugrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇātmajaṃ raṇe śailasānucaraṃ nāgaṃ vēgavān iva kēsarī ।।
utpāṭya ca mahāvṛkṣān aśvakarṇādikān bahūn anyāṃś ca vividhān vṛkṣāṃś ca cikṣēpa sa mahākapiḥ ।।
tāṃ chādayantīm ākāśaṃ vṛkṣavṛṣṭiṃ durāsadām kumbhakarṇātmajaḥ śrīmāṃś cicchēda svaśaraiḥ śitaiḥ ।।
[abhilakṣēṇa tīvrēṇa kumbhēna niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ] arditās tē drumā rējur yathā ghōrā ṣataghnayaḥ drumavarṣaṃ tu tad bhinnaṃ dṛṣṭvā kumbhena vīryavān ।।
vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmān mahāsattvō na vivyathē sa vidhyamānaḥ sahasā sahamānas tu tāñ charān ।।
kumbhasya dhanur ākṣipya babhañjēndradhanuṣprabham avaplutya tataḥ śīghraṃ kṛtvā karmasuduṣkaram ।।
abravīt kupitaḥ kumbhaṃ bhagnaśṛṅgam iva dvipam nikumbhāgraja vīryaṃ tē bāṇavēgaṃ tad adbhutam ।।
saṃnatiś ca prabhāvaś ca tava vā rāvaṇasya vā prahlādabalivṛtraghnakubhēravaruṇōpama ।।
ēkas tvam anujātō ‘si pitaraṃ balavattaram tvām ēvaikaṃ mahābāhuṃ śūlahastam ariṃdamam ।।
tataḥ kumbhas tu sugrīvaṃ bāhubhyāṃ jagṛhē tadā . gajāv ivāvītamadau niḥśvasantau muhur muhuḥ ।।76.
tataḥ kumbhaḥ samutpatya sugrīvam abhipātya ca . ājaghānōrasi kruddhō vajrakalpena muṣṭinā ।।
tasya vēgēna tatrāsīt tējaḥ prajvalitaṃ mahat . vajraniṣpēṣasaṃjātā jvālā mērōr yathā girēḥ ।।
muṣṭinābhihatas tēnanipapātāśurākṣasaḥ . lōhitāṅga ivākāśād dīptaraśmir yadṛcchayā ।।
urōgatēna niṣkēṇa bhujasthair aṅgadair api . kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca citrābhyāṃ mālayā ca vicitrayā ।।
parivārya mahākāyā mahākāyaṃ kharātmajam . abhijaghnus tatō hṛṣṭāś cālayantō nabhastalām ।।
prabhraṣṭō ‘tha karāt tasya pratōdaḥ sārathēs tadā . papāta sahasā daivād dhvajas tasya tu rakṣasaḥ ।।
ghanagajamahiṣāṅgatulyavarṇāḥ samaramukhēṣv asakṛd gadāsibhinnāḥ . aham aham iti yuddhakauśalās tē rajanīcarāḥ paribabhramur muhus te ।।
śaktikhaḍgagadākuntais tomaraiś ca niśācarāḥ paṭṭasair bhindipālaiś ca bāṇapātaiḥ samantataḥ R_6,066.
pāśamudgaradaṇḍaiś ca nirghātaiś cāparais tathā kadanaṃ kapisiṃhānāṃ cakrus te rajanīcarāḥ R_6,066.
yat tadā daṇḍakāraṇye pitaraṃ hatavān mama tadagrataḥ svakarmasthaṃ smṛtvā roṣo 'bhivardhate R_6,066.
evam uktas tu rāmeṇa kharaputro niśācaraḥ bāṇaughān asṛjat tasmai rāghavāya raṇājire R_6,066.
tāñ śarāñ śaravarṣeṇa rāmaś ciccheda naikadhā nipetur bhuvi vichinnā rukmapuṅkhāḥ suvāsasāḥ R_6,066.
tad yuddham abhavat tatra sametyānyonyam ojasā khararākṣasaputrasya sūnor daśarathasya ca R_6,066.
rāmamuktāṃs tu bāṇaughān rākṣasas tv acchinad raṇe rakṣomuktāṃs tu rāmo vai naikadhā prācchinac charaiḥ R_6,066.
bāṇaughavitatāḥ sarvā diśaś ca pradiśas tathā saṃchannā vasudhā caiva samantān na prakāśate R_6,066.
duravāpaṃ mahacchūlaṃ rudradattaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ jajvalyamānām ākāṣe saṃhārāstram ivāparam R_6,066.
sa krodhāt prāhiṇot tasmai rāghavāya mahāhave tam āpatantaṃ jvalitaṃ kharaputrakarāc cyutam R_6,066.
kupitaś ca tadā tatra kiṃ karyam iti cintayan ādideśātha saṃkruddho raṇāyendrajitaṃ sutam R_6,067.
pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhas taptahāṭakasaṃnibhaḥ havis tat pratijagrāha pāvakaḥ svayam utthitaḥ R_6,067.
sa vājibhiś caturbhis tu bāṇaiś ca niśitair yutaḥ āropitamahācāpaḥ śuśubhe syandanottame R_6,067.
jāmbūnadamahākambur dīptapāvakasaṃnibhaḥ babhūvendrajitaḥ ketur vaidūryasamalaṃkṛtaḥ R_6,067.
so 'bhiniryāya nagarād indrajit samitiṃjayaḥ hutvāgniṃ rākṣasair mantrair antardhānagato 'bravīt R_6,067.
sa tu vaihāyasaratho yudhi tau rāmalakṣmaṇau acakṣur viṣaye tiṣṭhan vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ R_6,067.
tau hanyamānau nārācair dhārābhir iva parvatau hemapuṅkhān naravyāghrau tigmān mumucatuḥ śarān R_6,067.
atimātraṃ śaraugheṇa dīpyamānau narottamau tān iṣūn patato bhallair anekair vicakartatuḥ R_6,067.
yato hi dadṛśāte tau śarān nipatitāñ cchitān tatas tu tau dāśarathī sasṛjāte 'stram uttamam R_6,067.
lakṣmaṇas tu tataḥ kruddho bhrātaraṃ vākyam abravīt brāhmam astraṃ prayokṣyāmi vadhārthaṃ sarvarakṣasām R_6,067.
parikliṣṭaikavasanām amṛjāṃ rāghavapriyām rajomalābhyām āliptaiḥ sarvagātrair varastriyam R_6,068.
abravīt tāṃ tu śokārtāṃ nirānandāṃ tapasvinām dṛṣṭvā rathastitāṃ dīnāṃ rākṣasendrasutāśritām R_6,068.
kiṃ samarthitam asyeti cintayan sa mahākapiḥ saha tair vānaraśreṣṭhair abhyadhāvata rāvaṇim R_6,068.
gṛhītamūrdhajāṃ dṛṣṭvā hanūmān dainyam āgataḥ duḥkhajaṃ vāri netrābhyām utsṛjan mārutātmajaḥ R_6,068.
iti bruvāṇo hanumān sāyudhair haribhir vṛtaḥ abhyadhāvat susaṃkruddho rākṣasendrasutaṃ prati R_6,068.
sugrīvas tvaṃ ca rāmaś ca yannimittam ihāgatāḥ tāṃ vadhiṣyāmi vaidehīm adyaiva tava paśyataḥ R_6,068.
na hantavyāḥ striyaś ceti yad bravīṣi plavaṃgama pīḍākaram amitrāṇāṃ yac ca kartavyam eva tat R_6,068.
tān uvāca tataḥ sarvān hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ viṣaṇṇavadanān dīnāṃs trastān vidravataḥ pṛthak R_6,069.
pṛṣṭhato ‘nuvrajadhvaṃ mām agrato yāntam āhave śūrair abhijanopetair ayuktaṃ hi nivartitum R_6,069.
evam uktāḥ susaṃkruddhā vāyuputreṇa dhīmatā śailaśṛṅgān drumāṃś caiva jagṛhur hṛṣṭamānasāḥ R_6,069.
abhipetuś ca garjanto rākṣasān vānararṣabhāḥ parivārya hanūmantam anvayuś ca mahāhave R_6,069.
sa tair vānaramukhyais tu hanūmān sarvato vṛtaḥ hutāśana ivārciṣmān adahac chatruvāhinīm R_6,069.
tām āpatantīṃ dṛṣṭvaiva rathaḥ sārathinā tadā vidheyāśvasamāyukto vidūram apavāhitaḥ R_6,069.
kṣipantīndrajitaṃ saṃhkye vānarā bhīmavikramāḥ vṛkṣaśailamahāvarṣaṃ visṛjantaḥ plavaṅgamāḥ 6,069.
śatrūṇāṃ kadanam cakrur neduś ca vividhaiḥ svanaiḥ vānarais tair mahābhīmair ghorarūpā niśācarāḥ R_6,069.
vīryād abhihatā vṛkṣair vyaceṣṭanta raṇakṣitau sa sainyam abhivīkṣyātha vānarārditam indrajit R_6,069.
pragṛhītāyudhaḥ kruddhaḥ parān abhimukho yayau sa śaraughān avasṛjan svasainyenābhisaṃvṛtaḥ R_6,069.
jaghāna kapiśārdūlān subahūn dṛḍhavikramaḥ śūlair aśanibhiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kūṭamudgaraiḥ te cāpy anucarāṃs tasya vānarā jaghnur āhave R_6,069.
saṃnivārya parānīkam abravīt tān vanaukasaḥ hanūmān saṃnivartadhvaṃ na naḥ sādhyam idaṃ balam R_6,069.
ity uktvā vānaraśreṣṭho vārayan sarvavānarān śanaiḥ śanair asaṃtrastaḥ sabalaḥ saṃnyavartata R_6,069.
nikumbhilām adhiṣṭhāya pāvakaṃ juhuvendrajit yajñabhūmyāṃ tato gatvā pāvakas tena rakṣasā R_6,069.
ṛkṣarājas tathety uktvā svenānīkena saṃvṛtaḥ āgacchat paścimaṃ dvāraṃ hanūmān yatra vānaraḥ R_6,070.
udbhrāntacittas tāṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣaṇṇo 'ham ariṃdama tad ahaṃ bhavato vṛttaṃ vijñāpayitum āgataḥ R_6,070.
asiñcan salilaiś cainaṃ padmotpalasugandhibhiḥ pradahantam asaṃhāryaṃ sahasāgnim ivotthitam R_6,070.
yady adharmo bhaved bhūto rāvaṇo narakaṃ vrajet bhavāṃś ca dharmasaṃyukto naiva vyasanam āpnuyāt R_6,070.
tasya ca vyasanābhāvād vyasanaṃ cāgate tvayi dharmo bhavaty adharmaś ca parasparavirodhitau R_6,070.
dharmeṇopalabhed dharmam adharmaṃ cāpy adharmataḥ yady adharmeṇa yujyeyur yeṣv adharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ R_6,070.
na dharmeṇa viyujyeran nādharmarucayo janāḥ dharmeṇa caratāṃ teṣaṃ tathā dharmaphalaṃ bhavet R_6,070.
yasmād arthā vivardhante yeṣv adharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ kliśyante dharmaśīlāś ca tasmād etau nirarthakau R_6,070.
uttiṣṭha naraśardūla dīrghabāho dhṛtavṛta kim ātmānaṃ mahātmānam ātmānaṃ nāvabudhyase R_6,070.
rāmam āśvāsamāne tu lakṣmaṇe bhrātṛvatsale nikṣipya gulmān svasthāne tatrāgacchad vibhīṣaṇaḥ R_6,071.
nānāpraharaṇair vīraiś caturbhir abhisaṃvṛtaḥ nīlāñjanacayākārair mātaṃgair iva yūthapaiḥ R_6,071.
rāghavaṃ ca mahātmānam ikṣvākukulanandanam dadarśa moham āpannaṃ lakṣmaṇasyāṅkam āśritam R_6,071.
vibhīṣaṇamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sugrīvaṃ tāṃś ca vānarān lakṣmaṇovāca mandārtham idaṃ bāṣpapariplutaḥ R_6,071.
hatām indrajitā sītām iha śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ hanūmadvacanāt saumya tato moham upāśritaḥ R_6,071.
caityaṃ nikumbhilām adya prāprya homaṃ kariṣyati hutavān upayāto hi devair api savāsavaiḥ R_6,071.
sasainyās tatra gacchāmo yāvat tan na samāpyate tyajainaṃ naraśārdūla mithyā saṃtāpam āgatam R_6,071.
bhūyas tu mama vijñāpyaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva mahāprabho tvayy akāraṇasaṃtapte saṃtaptahṛdayā vayam R_6,072.
tyaja rājann imaṃ śokaṃ mithyā saṃtāpam āgatam yad iyaṃ tyajyatāṃ cintā śatruharṣavivardhanī R_6,072.
nikumbhilāyāṃ saṃprāptaṃ hantuṃ rāvaṇim āhave dhanurmaṇḍalanirmuktair āśīviṣaviṣopamaiḥ R_6,072.
nikumbhilām asaṃprāptam akṛtāgniṃ ca yo ripuḥ tvām ātatāyinaṃ hanyād indraśatro sa te vadhaḥ R_6,072.
varo datto mahābāho sarvalokeśvareṇa vai ity evaṃ vihito rājan vadhas tasyaiṣa dhīmataḥ R_6,072.
rāghavas tu ripor jñātvā māyāvīryaṃ durātmanaḥ lakṣmaṇaṃ kīrtisaṃpannam idaṃ vacanam abravīt R_6,072.
jāmbavenarkṣapatinā saha sainyena saṃvṛtaḥ jahi taṃ rākṣasasutaṃ māyābalasamanvitam R_6,072.
saṃnaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī saśarī hemacāpabhṛt rāmapādāv upaspṛśya hṛṣṭaḥ saumitrir abravīt R_6,072.
vānarāṇāṃ sahasrais tu hanūmān bahubhir vṛtaḥ vibhīṣaṇaś ca sāmātyo lakṣmaṇam tvaritaṃ yayau R_6,072.
sa gatvā dūram adhvānaṃ saumitrir mitranandanaḥ rākṣasendrabalaṃ dūrād apaśyad vyūham āśritam R_6,072.
vividham amalaśastrabhāsvaraṃ tad dhvajagahanaṃ gahanaṃ mahārathaiś ca pratibhayatamam aprameyavegaṃ timiram iva dviṣatāṃ balaṃ viveśa R_6,072.
atha tasyām avasthāyāṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ rāvaṇānujaḥ pareṣām ahitaṃ vākyam arthasādhakam abravīt R_6,073.
yad etad rāksasānikaṃ meghaśyāmaṃ vilokyate etad ayodhyatāṃ śīghraṃ kapibhiś ca śilāyudhaiḥ R_6,073.
sa tvam indrāśaniprakhyaiḥ śarair avakiran parān abhidravāśu yāvad vai naitat karma samāpyate R_6,073.
ṛkṣāḥ śākhāmṛgāś caiva drumapravarayodhinaḥ abhyadhāvanta sahitās tad anīkam avasthitam R_6,073.
rākṣasāś ca śitair bāṇair asibhiḥ śaktitomaraiḥ abhyavartanta samare kapisainyajighāṃsavaḥ R_6,073.
śastraiś ca vividhākāraiḥ śitair bāṇaiś ca pādapaiḥ udyatair giriśṛṅgaiś ca ghorair ākāśam āvṛtam R_6,073.
tathaiva sakalair vṛkṣair giriśṛṅgaiś ca vānarāḥ abhijaghnur nijaghnuś ca samare sarvarākṣasān R_6,073.
ṛkṣavānaramukhyaiś ca mahākāyair mahābalaiḥ rakṣasāṃ vadhyamānānāṃ mahad bhayam ajāyata R_6,073.
svam anīkaṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ tu śrutvā śatrubhir arditam udatiṣṭhata durdharṣaḥ sa karmaṇy ananuṣṭhite R_6,073.
tasmiṃs tu kāle hanumān arujat sa durāsadam dharaṇīdharasaṃkāśo mahāvṛkṣam ariṃdamaḥ R_6,073.
sa rākṣasānāṃ tat sainyaṃ kālāgnir iva nirdahan cakāra bahubhir vṛkṣair niḥsaṃjñaṃ yudhi vānaraḥ R_6,073.
śitaśūladharāḥ śūlair asibhiś cāsipāṇayaḥ śaktihastāś ca śaktibhiḥ paṭṭasaiḥ paṭṭasāyudhāḥ R_6,073.
parighaiś ca gadābhiś ca kuntaiś ca śubhadarśanaiḥ śataśaś ca śataghnībhir āyasair api mudgaraiḥ R_6,073.
ghoraiḥ paraśubhiś caiva bhiṇḍipālaiś ca rākṣasāḥ muṣṭibhir vajravegaiś ca talair aśanisaṃnibhaiḥ R_6,073.
abhijaghnuḥ samāsādya samantāt parvatopamam teṣām api ca saṃkruddhaś cakāra kadanaṃ mahat R_6,073.
sa dadarśa kapiśreṣṭham acalopamam indrajit sūdamānam asaṃtrastam amitrān pavanātmajam R_6,073.
so 'bhyupetya śarān khaḍgān paṭṭiśāsiparaśvadhān abhyavarṣata durdharṣaḥ kapimūrdhani rākṣasaḥ R_6,073.
tathety uktvā mahātejāḥ saumitrir mitranandanaḥ babhūvāvasthitas tatra citraṃ visphārayan dhanuḥ R_6,074.
śocyas tvam asi durbuddhe nindanīyaś ca sādhubhiḥ yas tvaṃ svajanam utsṛjya parabhṛtyatvam āgataḥ R_6,074.
dharmāt pracyutaśīlaṃ hi puruṣaṃ pāpaniścayam tyaktvā sukham avapnoti hastād aśīviṣaṃ yathā R_6,074.
maharṣīṇāṃ vadho ghoraḥ sarvadevaiś ca vigrahaḥ abhimānaś ca kopaś ca vairitvaṃ pratikūlatā R_6,074.
ete doṣā mama bhrātur jīvitaiśvaryanāśanāḥ guṇān pracchādayāmāsuḥ parvatān iva toyadāḥ R_6,074.
atimānaś ca bālaś ca durvinītaś ca rākṣasa baddhas tvaṃ kālapāśena brūhi māṃ yad yad icchasi R_6,074.
adyeha vyasanaṃ prāptaṃ yan māṃ paruṣam uktavān praveṣṭuṃ na tvayā śakyaṃ nyagrodhaṃ rākṣasādhama R_6,074.
mahāpramāṇam udyamya vipulaṃ vegavad dṛḍham dhanur bhīmabalo bhīmaṃ śarāṃś cāmitranāśanān R_6,075.
hanūmatpṛṣṭham ārūḍham udayastharaviprabham uvācainaṃ susamārabdhaḥ saumitriṃ savibhīṣaṇam R_6,075.
tāṃś ca vānaraśārdūlān paśyadhvaṃ me parākramam adya matkārmukotsṛṣṭaṃ śaravarṣaṃ durāsadam R_6,075.
evam ukto dhanur bhīmaṃ parāmṛśya mahābalaḥ sasarja niśitān bāṇān indrajit samitiṃjaya R_6,075.
śarair atimahāvegair vegavān rāvaṇātmajaḥ saumitrim indrajid yuddhe vivyādha śubhalakṣaṇam R_6,075.
indrajit tv ātmanaḥ karma prasamīkṣyābhigamya ca vinadya sumahānādam idaṃ vacanam abravīt R_6,075.
ity uktvā pañca nārācān ākarṇāpūritāñ śarān vijaghāna mahāvegāṃl lakṣmaṇo rākṣasorasi R_6,075.
vikrāntau balasaṃpannāv ubhau vikramaśālinau ubhāv paramadurjeyāv atulyabalatejasau R_6,075.
tataḥ saṃdhāya saumitriḥ śarān aśīviṣopamān mumoca viśikhāms tasmin sarpān iva viṣolbaṇān R_6,076.
śakrāśanisamasparśair lakṣmaṇenāhataḥ śaraiḥ muhūrtam abhavan mūḍhaḥ sarvasaṃkṣubhitendriyaḥ R_6,076.
ity uktvā saptabhir bāṇair abhivivyādha lakṣmaṇam daśabhiś ca hanūmantaṃ tīkṣṇadhāraiḥ śarottamaiḥ R_6,076.
tad dṛṣṭvendrajitā karma kṛtaṃ rāmānujas tadā acintayitvā prahasan naitat kiṃ cid iti bruvan R_6,076.
tatakṣatur mahātmānau raṇakarmaviśaradau babhūvatuś cātmajaye yat tau bhīmaparākramau R_6,076.
tau śaraughais tathākīrṇau nikṛttakavacadhvajau sujantau rudhiraṃ coṣṇaṃ jalaṃ prasravaṇāv iva R_6,076.
śaravarṣaṃ tato ghoraṃ muñcato bhīmaniḥsvanam sāsārayor ivākāśe nīlayoḥ kālameghayoḥ R_6,076.
astrāṇy astravidāṃ śreṣṭhau darśayantau punaḥ punaḥ śarān uccāvacākārān antarikṣe babandhatuḥ R_6,076.
tayoḥ pṛthakpṛthag bhīmaḥ śuśruve tumulaḥ svanaḥ sa kampaṃ janayamāsa nirghāta iva darunaḥ R_6,076.
tayoḥ sa bhrajate śabdas tathā samarayattayoḥ sughorayor niḥsvanayor gagane meghayor iva R_6,076.
anye suniśitaiḥ śastrair ākāśe saṃjaghaṭṭire babhañjuś cicchiduś caiva tayor bāṇāḥ sahasraśaḥ R_6,076.
sa babhūva raṇe ghoras tayor bāṇamayaś cayaḥ agnibhyām iva dīptābhyāṃ satre kuśamayaś ca yaḥ R_6,076.
cakratus tumulaṃ ghoraṃ saṃnipātaṃ muhur muhuḥ indrajil lakṣmaṇaś caiva parasparajayaiṣiṇau R_6,076.
tayor atha mahān kālo vyatīyād yudhyamānayoḥ na ca tau yuddhavaimukhyaṃ śramaṃ vāpy upajagmatuḥ R_6,076.
atha samarapariśramaṃ nihantuṃ samaramukheṣv ajitasya lakṣmaṇasya priyahitam upapādayan mahātmā samaram upetya vibhīṣaṇo 'vatasthe R_6,076.
tayor yuddhaṃ draṣṭakāmo varacāpadharo balī śūraḥ sa rāvaṇabhrātā tasthau saṃgrāmamūrdhani R_6,077.
eko 'yaṃ rākṣasendrasya parāyaṇam avasthitaḥ etac cheṣaṃ balaṃ tasya kiṃ tiṣṭhata harīśvarāḥ R_6,077.
prahasto nihato vīro nikumbhaś ca mahābalaḥ kumbhakarṇaś ca kumbhaś ca dhūmrākṣaś ca niśācaraḥ R_6,077.
jambumalī mahāmalī tīkṣṇavego ‘śaniprabhaḥ suptaghno yajñakopaś ca vajradaṃṣtraś ca rākṣasaḥ R_6,077.
saṃhrādī vikaṭo ‘righnas tapano manda eva ca praghāsaḥ praghasaś caiva prajaṅgho jaṅgha eva ca R_6,077.
agniketuś ca durdharśo raśmiketuś ca vīryavān vidyujjihvo dvijihvaś ca sūryaśatruś ca rākṣasaḥ R_6,077.
akampanaḥ supārśvaś ca cakramālī ca rākṣasaḥ kampanaḥ sattvavantaś ca devāntakanarāntakau R_6,077.
vānarā ghnata saṃbhūya bhṛtyān asya samīpagān iti tenātiyaśasā rākṣasenābhicoditāḥ R_6,077.
vānarendrā jahṛṣire lāṅgalāni ca vivyadhuḥ tatas te kapiśārdūlāḥ kṣveḍantaś ca punaḥ punaḥ mumucur vividhān nādān meghān dṛṣṭveva barhiṇaḥ R_6,077.
jāmbavān api taiḥ sarvaiḥ sayūthyair abhisaṃvṛtaḥ te ‘śmabhis tāḍayām āsur nakhair dantaiś ca rākṣasān R_6,077.
nighnantam ṛkṣādhipatiṃ rākṣasās te mahābalāḥ paribhartsya bhayaṃ tyaktvā tam anekavidhāyudhāḥ R_6,077.
rakṣasāṃ kadanaṃ cakre durāsādaḥ sahasraśaḥ R_ sa dattvā tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ pitṛvyasyendrajid balī R_6,077.
śaraughān abhivarṣantau jaghnatus tau parasparam abhīkṣṇam antardadhatuḥ śarajālair mahābalau R_6,077.
candrādityāv ivoṣṇānte yathā meghais tarasvinau na hy ādānaṃ na saṃdhānaṃ dhanuṣo vā parigrahaḥ R_6,077.
adṛśyata tayos tatra yudhyatoḥ pāṇilāghavāt cāpavegaprayuktaiś ca bāṇajālaiḥ samantataḥ R_6,077.
antarikṣe 'bhisaṃpanne na rūpāṇi cakāśire lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇiṃ prāpya rāvaṇiś cāpi lakṣmaṇam R_6,077.
avyavasthā bhavaty ugrā tābhyām anyonyavigrahe tābhyām ubhābhyāṃ tarasā pravṛṣṭair viśikhaiḥ śitaiḥ R_6,077.
nirantaram ivākāśaṃ babhūva tamasā vṛtam taiḥ patadbhiś ca bahubhis tayoḥ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ R_6,077.
diśaś ca pradiśaś caiva babhūvuḥ śarasaṃkulāḥ tamasā pihitaṃ sarvam āsīt pratibhayaṃ mahat R_6,077.
astaṃ gate sahasrāṃśau saṃvṛte tamasā ca vai rudhiraughā mahānadyaḥ prāvartanta sahasraśaḥ 6,077.
atha rākṣasasiṃhasya kṛṣṇān kanakabhūṣaṇān śaraiś caturbhiḥ saumitrir vivyādha caturo hayān R_6,077.
tato 'pareṇa bhallena pītena niśitena ca saṃpūrṇāyatamuktena supatreṇa suvarcasā R_6,077.
svayaṃ sārathyam akarot punaś ca dhanur aspṛśat tad adbhutam abhūt tatra sārathyaṃ paśyatāṃ yudhi R_6,077.
te hayā mathitā bhagnā vyasavo dharaṇīṃ gatāḥ te nihatya hayāṃs tasya pramathya ca mahāratham punar utpatya vegena tasthur lakṣmaṇapārśvataḥ R_6,077.
sa hatāśvād avaplutya rathān mathitasārathiḥ śaravarṣeṇa saumitrim abhyadhāvata rāvaṇiḥ R_6,077.
tato mahendrapratimaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ padātinaṃ taṃ nihatair hayottamaiḥ mṛjantam ājau niśitāñ śarottamān bhṛśaṃ tadā bāṇagaṇair vyadārayat R_6,077.
nibarhayantaś cānyonyaṃ te rākṣasavanaukasaḥ bhartāraṃ na jahur yuddhe saṃpatantas tatas tataḥ R_6,078.
tatas tān rākṣasān sarvān harṣayan rāvanātmajaḥ stunvāno harṣamānaś ca idaṃ vacanam abravīt R_6,078.
adhiṣṭhitaṃ hayajñēna sūtēnāptōpadēśinā . ārurōha mahātējā rāvaṇiḥ samatiñjayaḥ ।।
sa rākaṣasagaṇair mukhayair vṛtō mandōdarīsutaḥ . nirayayau nagarād vīraḥ kṛtāntabalacōditaḥ ।।
sō ‘bhiniṣkramya nagarād inadarajit paramaujasā . abhyayāj javanair aśvair lakaṣamaṇaṃ savibhīṣaṇam ।।
tatō rathastham ālōkya saumatarī rāvaṇātmajam . vānarāś ca mahāvīryā rākaṣasaś ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।।
vismayaṃ paramaṃ jagmur lāghavāt tasya dhīmataḥ rāvaṇiś cāpi saṃkruddhō raṇē vānarayūthapān।।
harīn abhyahanat kruddhaḥ paraṃ lāghavam āsthitaḥ tē vadhyamānā harayō nārācair bhīmavikramaiḥ ।।
sō ‘nyat kārmukam ādāya sajjaṃ cakrē tvarann iva tadapyasya tribhir bāṇair lakṣamaṇō nirakṛntata ।।
muktam indrajitā tat tu śaravarṣam ariṃdamaḥ avārayad asaṃbhrānto lakṣmaṇaḥ sudurāsadam R_6,078.
tatas tān rākṣasān sarvāṃs tribhir ēkaikam āhavē avidhyat paramakruddhaḥ śīghrāstraṃ sampradarśayan . rākṣasēndras tu taṃ cāpi bāṇaughaiḥ samtāḍayat ।।
tān aprāptān śitair bāṇaiś cicchēda paravīrahā . sārathēr asya ca raṇē rathinō rathasattamaḥ ।।
śirō jahāra dharmātmā bhallēnānataparvaṇā asūtās tē hayās tatra ratham ūhur avikalavāḥ ।।
maṇḍalāny abhidhāvanti tad adbhutam ivābhavat amarṣavaśam āpannaḥ saumitrir dṛḍhavikaramaḥ ।।
pratyaviddhyad hayāṃs tasya śarair vitrāsayan raṇē amarṣamāṇas tatkarma rāvaṇasya sutō raṇē ।।
avidhyat paramakruddhaḥ śīghram astraṃ pradarśayan taiḥ pṛṣatkair lalāṭasthaiḥ śuśubhe raghunandanaḥ R_6,078.
raṇāgre samaraślāghī triśṛṅga iva parvataḥ sa tathāpy ardito bāṇai rākṣasena tadā mṛdhe R_6,078.
tau parasparam abhyetya sarvagātreṣu dhanvinau ghorair vivyadhatur bāṇaiḥ kṛtabhāvāv ubhau jaye R_6,078.
ayomukhais tribhir baddhvā rākṣasendraṃ vibhīṣaṇam ekaikān abhivivyādha tān sarvān hariyūthapān R_6,078.
tam āpatantim saṃprekṣya sumitrānandavardhanaḥ ciccheda niśitair bāṇair daśadhāpātayad bhuvi R_6,078.
saṃnipātas tayoś casīc charayor ghorarūpayoḥ sadhumavisphulingaś ca tajjo’gnidaruno’bhavat R_6,078.
sa saṃrabdhas tu saumitrir astraṃ vāruṇam ādade raudraṃ mahedrajid yuddhe ‘py asṛjad yudhaviṣṭhitaḥ R_6,078.
ādade niśitaṃ bāṇam āsuraṃ śatrudāraṇam tasmāc cāpad viniṣpetur bhāsvarāḥ kūṭamudgarāḥ R_6,078.
śūlāni ca bhuśuṇḍyaś ca gadāḥ khaḍgāḥ paraśvadhāḥ tad dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaḥ saṃkhye ghoram astraṃ pratyavārayat R_6,078.
avāryaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvaśastravidārayan maheśvareṇa dyutimaṃs tad astraṃ pratyavārayat R_6,078.
durāvāraṃ durviṣamaṃ rākṣasānāṃ bhayāvaham āśīviṣaviṣaprakhyaṃ devasaṃghaiḥ samarcitam R_6,078.
athaindram astraṃ saumitriḥ saṃyugeṣv aparājitam śaraśreṣṭhaṃ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhe naraśreṣṭho vikarṣann idam abravīt R_6,078.

[saṃdhāyāmitradalanaṃ vicakarṣa śarāsanam sajyam āyamya durdharśaḥ kālo lokakṣaye yathā saṃdhāya dhanuṣi śreṣṭhe vikarṣann idam abravīt] lakṣmīvāṃl lakṣmaṇo vākyam arthasādhakam ātmanaḥ dharmātmā satyasaṃdhaś ca rāmo dāśarathir yadi pauruṣe cāpratidvandvas tadainaṃ jahi rāvaṇim R_6,078.
tac chiraḥ saśirastrāṇaṃ śrīmaj jvalitakuṇḍalam pramathyendrajitaḥ kāyāt pātayāmāsa bhūtale R_6,078.
vanarair vadhyamānās te śastrāṇy utsṛjya rākṣasāḥ laṅkām abhimukhāḥ sasrur bhraṣṭasaṃjñāḥ pradhāvitāḥ R_6,078.
śuddhā āpo nabhaś caiva jahṛṣur devadānavāḥ ājagmuḥ patite tasmin sarvalokabhayāvahe R_6,078.
ūcuś ca sahitās tuṣṭā devagandharvadānavāḥ vijvarāḥ śāntakaluṣā brāhmaṇā vicarantv iti R_6,078.
vibhīṣaṇo hanūmāṃś ca jāmbavāṃś carkṣayūthapaḥ vijayenābhinandantas tuṣṭuvuś cāpi lakṣmaṇam R_6,078.
rudhiraklinnagātras tu lakṣmaṇaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ babhūva hṛṣṭas taṃ hatvā śakrajetāram āhave R_6,079.
tataḥ sa jāmbavantaṃ ca hanūmantaṃ ca vīryavān saṃnipatya mahātejās tāṃś ca sarvān vanaukasaḥ R_6,079.
sa taṃ śirasy upāghrāya lakṣmaṇaṃ kīrtivardhanam lajjamānaṃ balāt snehād aṅkam aropya vīryavān R_6,079.
mūrdhni cainam upāghrāya bhūyaḥ saṃspṛśya ca tvaran uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyam āśvāsya puruṣarṣabhaḥ R_6,079.
chinno hi dakṣiṇo bāhuḥ sa hi tasya vyapāśrayaḥ vibhīṣaṇahanūmadbhyāṃ kṛtaṃ karma mahad raṇe R_6,079.
ahorātrais tribhir vīraḥ kathaṃcid vinipātitaḥ niramitraḥ kṛto 'smy adya niryāsyati hi rāvaṇaḥ R_6,079.
viśalyo 'yaṃ mahāprājñaḥ saumitrir mitravatsalaḥ yathā bhavati susvasthas tathā tvaṃ samudācara R_6,079.
viśalyaḥ kriyatāṃ kṣipraṃ saumitriḥ mitravatsalaḥ ṛkṣavānarasainyānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ drumayodhinām R_6,079.
ye cāpy anyo 'tra yudhyanti saśalyā vraṇinas tathā te 'pi sarve prayatnena kriyatāṃ sukhinas tathā R_6,079.
tataḥ prakṛtim āpanno hṛtaśalyo gataklamaḥ saumitrir mumude tatra kṣaṇena vigatajvaraḥ R_6,079.

tathaiva rāmaḥ plavagādhipas tadā vibhīṣaṇaś carkṣapatiś ca vīryavān avekṣya saumitrim arogam utthitaṃ mudā sasainyaḥ suciraṃ jaharṣire R_6,028. apūjayat karma sa lakṣmaṇasya suduṣkaraṃ dāśarathir mahātmā babhūva hṛṣṭo yudhi vānarendro niśamya taṃ śakrajitaṃ nipātitam R_6,079.
tataḥ paulastyasacivāḥ śrutvā cendrajito vadham ācacakṣur avajñāya daśagrīvāya satvarāḥ R_6,080.
ghoram indrajitaḥ saṃkhye kaśmalaṃ prāviśan mahat upalabhya cirāt saṃjñāṃ rājā rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ R_6,080.
putraśokaṇkulo dīno vilalāpākulendriyaḥ hā rākṣasacamūmukhya mama vatsa mahābala R_6,080.
jitvendraṃ katham adya tvaṃ lakṣmaṇasya vaśaṃ gataḥ nanu tvam iṣubhiḥ kruddho bhindyāḥ kālāntakāv api R_6,080.
yenādya tvaṃ mahābāho saṃyuktaḥ kāladharmaṇā R_6,080.
prakṛtyā kopena hy enaṃ putrasya punar ādhayaḥ dīptaṃ saṃdīpayāmāsur gharme ‘rkam iva raśmayaḥ R_6,080.
[lalāte bhrūkuṭībhiś ca saṃgatabhir vyarocata yugānte saha nakrais tu mahormibhir ivodadhiḥ] kopad vijṛbhamāṇasya vakrād vyaktam iva javalan utpapāta sadhūmagnir vṛtrasya vadanād iva R_6,080.
dantān vidaśatas tasya śrūyate daśanasvanaḥ yantrasyākṛṣyamāṇasya mathnato dānavair iva R_6,080.
tena mām adya saṃyuktaṃ rathastham iha saṃyuge pratīyāt ko 'dya mām ājau sākṣād api puraṃdaraḥ R_6,080.
adya tūryaśatair bhīmaṃ dhanur utthāpyatāṃ mama rāmalakṣmaṇayor eva vadhāya paramāhave R_6,080.
tad idaṃ tathyam evāhaṃ kariṣye priyam ātmanaḥ vaidehīṃ nāśayiṣyāmi kṣatrabandhum anuvratām ity evam uktvā sacivān khaḍgam āśu parāmṛśat R_6,080.
rāvaṇaḥ putraśokena bhṛśam ākulacetanaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ khaḍgam ādāya sahasā yatra maithilī R_6,080.
bahuśaś codayām āsa bhartāraṃ mām anuvratām bhāryā mama bhavasveti pratyākhyāto dhruvaṃ mayā R_6,080.
so 'yaṃ mām anupasthāne vyaktaṃ nairāśyam āgataḥ krodhamohasamāviṣṭo vyaktaṃ māṃ hantum udyataḥ R_6,080.
vidhamiṣyati māṃ raudro rākṣasaḥ pāpaniścayaḥ hanūmatas tu tadvākyaṃ na kṛtaṃ kṣudrayā mayā R_6,080.
yady ahaṃ tasya pṛṣṭhena tadāyāsam anirjitā nādyaivam anuśoceyaṃ bhartur aṅkagatā satī R_6,080.
dhig astu kubjām asatīṃ mantharāṃ pāpaniścayām yannimittam idaṃ śokaṃ kausalyā pratipatsyate R_6,080.
ity evaṃ maithilīṃ dṛṣṭvā vilapantīṃ tapasvinīm rohiṇīm iva candreṇa vinā grahavaśaṃ gatām R_6,080.
etasminn antare tasya amātyaḥ śīlavāñ chuciḥ supārśvo nāma medhāvī rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasāṃ varam nivāryamāṇaḥ sacivair idaṃ vacanam abravīt R_6,080.
vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ svakarmaniratas tathā striyāḥ kasmād vadhaṃ vīra manyase rākṣaseśvara R_6,080.
maithilīṃ rūpasaṃpannāṃ pratyavekṣasva pārthiva tasminn eva sahāsmābhir āhave krodham utsṛja R_6,080.
abhyutthānaṃ tvam adyaiva kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśī kṛtvā niryāhy amāvāsyāṃ vijayāya balair vṛtaḥ R_6,080.
abravīc ca tadā sarvān balamukhyān mahābalaḥ rāvaṇaḥ prāñjalīr vākyaṃ putravyasanakarśitaḥ R_6,081.
ity etad vākyaṃ ādāya rākṣasendrasya rākṣasāḥ niryayus te rathaiḥ śīghrair nānānīkaiś ca saṃvṛtāḥ R_6,081.
keśān karṇalalāṭaṃ ca nāsikāś ca plavaṃgamāḥ rakṣasāṃ daśanais tīkṣṇair nakhaiś cāpi vyakartayan R_6,081.
tadā gadābhir gurvībhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ nirjaghnur vānarān ghorān rākṣasāḥ parvatopamāḥ R_6,081.
eṣa hanti gajānīkam eṣa hanti mahārathān eṣa hanti śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ padātīn vājibhiḥ saha R_6,081.
iti te rākṣasāḥ sarve rāmasya sadṛśān raṇe anyonyaṃ kupitā jaghnuḥ sādṛśyād rāghavasya tu R_6,081.
divyāstraguṇaparyantaṃ nighnantaṃ yudhi rākṣasān dadṛśū rāmacakraṃ tat kālacakram iva prajāḥ R_6,081.
anīkaṃ daśasāhasraṃ rathānāṃ vātaraṃhasām aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi kuñjarāṇāṃ tarasvinām R_6,081.
divasasyāṣṭabhāgena śarair agniśikhopamaiḥ hatāny ekena rāmeṇa rakṣasāṃ kāmarūpiṇām R_6,081.
hatair gajapadātyaśvais tad babhūva raṇājiram ākrīḍabhūmīḥ kruddhasya rudrasyeva mahātmanaḥ R_6,081.
jāmbavantaṃ hariśreṣṭhaṃ maindaṃ dvividam eva ca etad astrabalaṃ bhīmaṃ mama vā tryambakasya vā R_6,081.
tāni nāgasahasrāṇi sārohāṇi ca vājinām rathānāṃ tv agnivarṇānāṃ sadhvajānāṃ sahasraśaḥ R_6,082.
rākṣasānāṃ sahasrāṇi gadāparighayodhinām kāñcanadhvajacitrāṇāṃ śūrāṇāṃ kāmarūpiṇām R_6,082.
nihatāni śarair dīpais taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ rāvaṇena prayuktāni rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā R_6,082.
vidhavā hataputrāś ca krośantyo hatabāndhavāḥ rākṣasyaḥ saha saṃgamya duḥkhārtāḥ paryadevayan R_6,082.
janasyāsyālpabhāgyatvāt valinī śvetamūrdhajā akāryam apahāsyaṃ ca sarvalokavigarhitam R_6,082.
kharaś ca nihataḥ saṃkhye dūṣaṇas triśirās tathā śarair ādityasaṃkāśaiḥ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam R_6,082.
rathāśvanāgāś ca hatās tatra tatra sahasraśaḥ raṇe rāmeṇa śūreṇa rākṣasāś ca padātayaḥ R_6,082.
rāmahastād daśagrīvaḥ śūro dattamahāvaraḥ idaṃ bhayaṃ mahāghoram samutpannaṃ na budhyate R_6,082.
pīḍyamānās tu balinā varadānena rakṣasā dīptais tapobhir vibudhāḥ pitāmaham apūjayan R_6,082.
daivatais tu samāgamya sarvaiś cendrapurogamaiḥ vṛṣadhvajas tripurahā mahādevaḥ pratoṣitaḥ R_6,082.
saṃdaśya daśanair oṣṭhaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ rākṣasair api durdarśaḥ kālāgnir iva mūrtimān R_6,083.
uvāca ca samīpasthān rākṣasān rākṣaseśvaraḥ krodhāvyaktakathas tatra nirdahann iva cakṣuṣā R_6,083.
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasās te bhayārditāḥ codayām āsur avyagrān rākṣasāṃs tān nṛpājñayā R_6,083.
kharasya kumbhakarṇasya prahastendrajitos tathā kariṣyāmi pratīkāram adya śatruvadhād aham R_6,083.
hato bhratā ca yeṣāṃ vai yeṣāṃ ca tanayo hataḥ vadhenādya ripos teṣāṃ karomy aśrupramārjanam R_6,083.
adya madbāṇanirbhinnaiḥ prastīrṇair gatacetanaiḥ karomi vānarair yuddhe yatnāvekṣyatalāṃ mahīm R_6,083.
adya kākāś ca gṛdhrāś ca ye ca māṃsāśino 'pare sarvāṃs tāṃs tarpayiṣyāmi śatrumāṃsaiḥ śarāhataiḥ R_6,083.
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā mahāpārśvo 'bravīd vacaḥ balādhyakṣān sthitāṃs tatra balaṃ saṃtvaryatām iti R_6,083.
balādhyakṣās tu saṃyuktā rākṣasāṃs tān gṛhe gṛhe codayantaḥ pariyayur laṅkāṃ laghuparākramāḥ R_6,083.
tato muhūrtān niṣpetū rākṣasā bhīmadarśanāḥ nadanto bhīmavadanā nānāpraharaṇair bhujaiḥ R_6,083.
asibhiḥ paṭṭasaiḥ śūlair gadābhir musalair halaiḥ śaktibhis tīkṣṇadhārābhir mahadbhiḥ kūṭamudgaraiḥ R_6,083.
yaṣṭibhir vividhaiś cakrair niśitaiś ca paraśvadhaiḥ bhiṇḍipālaiḥ śataghnībhir anyaiś cāpi varāyudhaiḥ R_6,083.
athānayan balādhyakṣāś catvāro rāvaṇājñayā rathānām niyutaṃ sāgraṃ nāgānāṃ niyutatrayam R_6,083.
aśvānāṃ ṣaṣṭikotyas tu kharoṣṭrāṇaṃ tathaiva ca padātayas tv asaṃkhyātā jagmus te rājaśāsanāt R_6,083.
balādhyakṣāś ca saṃstāpya rājñaḥ senāṃ purasthitām etasminn antare sūtaḥ sthāpayāmāsa taṃ ratham R_6,083.
divyāstravarasaṃpannaṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitam nānāyudhasamākīrṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālasaṃyutam R_6,083.
nānāratnaparikṣiptaṃ ratnastambhair virājitaṃ jambūnadamayaiś caiva sahasrakalaśair vṛtam R_6,083.
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasāḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ R_6,083.
rāvaṇenābhyanujñātau mahāpārśvamahodarau virūpākṣaś ca durdharṣo rathān āruruhus tadā R_6,083.
nayanaṃ cāsphurad vāmaṃ vāmo bāhur akampata vivarṇavadanaś cāsīt kiṃ cid abhraśyata svaraḥ R_6,083.
antarikṣāt papātolkā nirghātasamanisvanā vinedur aśivaṃ gṛdhrā vāyasair abhimiśritāḥ R_6,083.
etān acintayan ghorān utpātān samupasthitān niryayau rāvaṇo mohād vadhārthaṃ kālacoditaḥ R_6,083.
teṣāṃ tu rathaghoṣeṇa rākṣasānāṃ mahātmanām vānarāṇām api camūr yuddhāyaivābhyavartata [teṣāṃ tu tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva kapirakṣasām] anyonyam āhvayānānāṃ kruddhānāṃ jayam icchatām R_6,083.
nikṛttaśirasaḥ ke cid rāvaṇena valīmukhāḥ kecid vichinnahṛdayāḥ kecic chrotravivarjitāh R_6,083.
nirucchvāsā hatāḥ ke cit ke cit pārśveṣu dāritāḥ ke cid vibhinnaśirasaḥ ke cic cakṣurvinikṛtāḥ R_6,083.
plavaṃgānām anīkāni mahābhrāṇīva mārutaḥ saṃyayau samare tasmin vidhaman rāvaṇaḥ śaraiḥ R_6,084.
pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhataś cāsya sarve vānarayūthapāḥ anujagmur mahāśailān vividhāṃś ca vanaspatīn R_6,084.
nanarda yudhi sugrīvaḥ svareṇa mahatā mahān pothayan vividhāṃś cānyā mamanthottamarākṣasān R_6,084.
kapirājavimuktais taiḥ śailavarṣais tu rākṣasāḥ vikīrṇaśirasaḥ petur vikīrṇā iva parvatāḥ R_6,084.
virūpākṣaḥ svakaṃ nāma dhanvī viśrāvya rākṣasaḥ rathād āplutya durdharṣo gajaskandham upāruhat R_6,084.
sa taṃ dvipam athāruhya virūpākṣo mahābalaḥ nanarda bhīmanirhrādaṃ vānarān abhyadhāvata R_6,084.
sugrīve sa śarān ghorān visasarja camūmukhe sthāpayām āsā codvignān rākṣasān saṃpraharṣayan R_6,084.
gajāt tu mathitāt tūrṇam apakramya sa vīryavān rākṣaso 'bhimukhaḥ śatruṃ pratyudgamya tataḥ kapim R_6,084.
ārṣabhaṃ carma khaḍgaṃ ca pragṛhya laghuvikramaḥ bhartsayann iva sugrīvam āsasāda vyavasthitam R_6,084.
tena khaḍgaprahāreṇa rakṣasā balinā tadā muhūrtam abhavad bhūmau visaṃjña iva vānaraḥ R_6,084.
kavacaṃ pātayām āsa sa padbhyābhihato 'patat sa samutthāya patitaḥ kapis tasya vyasarjayat R_6,084.
talaprahāram aśaneḥ samānaṃ bhīmanisvanam talaprahāraṃ tad rakṣaḥ sugrīveṇa samudyatam R_6,084.
naipuṇyān mocayitvainaṃ muṣṭinorasi tāḍayat tatas tu saṃkruddhataraḥ sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ R_6,084.
tato ‘nyaṃ pātayat krodhāc chaṅkhadeśe mahātalam mahendrāśanikalpena talenābhihataḥ kṣitau R_6,084.
papāta rudhiraklinnaḥ śoṇitaṃ hi samudgiran srotobhyas tu virūpakṣo jalaṃ prasravaṇād iva R_6,084.
tatas te vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasānāṃ mahāmṛdhe diśo daśa drutāḥ kecit kecit sugrīvam āśritāḥ R_6,085.
tām āpatantīṃ sahasā śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahodaraḥ asaṃbhrāntas tato bāṇair nirbibheda tataḥ śilām R_6,085.
ājaghāna gadāṃ tasya parigheṇa harīśvaraḥ papāta tarasā bhinnaḥ parighas tasya bhūtale R_6,085.
sa taṃ udyamya cikṣepa so 'py asya prākṣipad gadām bhinnāv anyonyam āsādya petatus tau mahītale R_6,085.
jaghnatus tau tadānyonyaṃ nadantau ca punaḥ punaḥ talaiś cānyonyam āsādya petatuś ca mahītale R_6,085.
utpetatus tadā tūrṇaṃ jaghnatuś ca parasparam bhujaiś cikṣepatur vīrāv anyonyam aparājitau R_6,085.
atha vijayam avāpya vānarendraḥ samaramukhe surasiddhayakṣasanghaiḥ avanitalagataiś ca bhūtasaṅghair haruṣasamākulitair nirīkṣamāṇaḥ R_6,085.
aṅgadasya camūṃ bhīmāṃ kṣobhayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ sa vānarāṇāṃ mukhyānām uttamāṅgāni rākṣasaḥ R_6,086.
pātayām āsa kāyebhyaḥ phalaṃ vṛntād ivānilaḥ keṣāṃ cid iṣubhir bāhūṃś cichedātha sa rākṣasaḥ R_6,086.
vānarāṇāṃ susaṃrabdhaḥ pārśvaṃ keṣāṃcid akṣipat te 'rditā bāṇavarṣeṇa mahāpārśvena vānarāḥ R_6,086.
viṣādavimukhāḥ sarve babhūvur gatacetasaḥ niśamya balam udvignam aṅgado rākṣasārditam R_6,086.
vegaṃ cakre mahāvegaḥ samudra iva parvasu āyasaṃ parighaṃ gṛhya sūryaraśmisamaprabham R_6,086.
tasya rkṣarājas tejasvī nīlāñjanacayopamaḥ niṣpatya sumahāvīryaḥ svayūthān meghasaṃnibhāt R_6,086.
muhūrtāl labdhasaṃjñas tu mahāpārśvo mahābalaḥ aṅgadaṃ bahubhir bāṇair bhūyas taṃ pratyavidhyata R_6,086.
tasyāṅgadaḥ saroṣākṣo rākṣasasya tam āyasaṃ dūrasthitasya parighaṃ raviraśmisamaprabham R_6,086.
sa vīro vajrasaṃkāśam aṅgado muṣṭim ātmanaḥ saṃvartayat susaṃkruddhaḥ pitus tulyaparākramaḥ R_6,086.
tasmin vinihate bhūmau tat sainyaṃ saṃpracukṣubhe abhavac ca mahān krodhaḥ samare rāvaṇasya tu R_6,086.
athenraśatrus tridaśālayānāṃ vanaukasāṃ caiva mahāpraṇādam śrutvā saroṣaṃ yudhi rākṣasendraḥ punaś ca yuddhābhimukho ‘vatasthe R_6,086.
mahodaramahāpārśvau hatau dṛṣṭvā sa rāvaṇaḥ tasmiṃś ca nihate vīre virūpākṣe mahābale R_6,087.
āviveśa mahān krodho rāvaṇaṃ tu mahāmṛdhe sūtaṃ saṃcodayām āsa vākyaṃ cedam uvāca ha R_6,087.
dvividaś caiva maindaś ca aṅgado gandhamādanaḥ hanūmāṃś ca suṣeṇaś ca sarve ca hariyūthapāḥ R_6,087.
sa diśo daśa ghoṣeṇa rathasyātiratho mahān nādayan prayayau tūrṇaṃ rāghavaṃ cābhyadhāvata R_6,087.
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā viṣṇunā vāsavaṃ yathā ālikhantam ivākāśam avaṣṭabhya mahad dhanuḥ R_6,087.
padmapatraviśālākṣaṃ dīrghabāhum ariṃdamam tato rāmo mahātejāḥ saumitrisahito balī R_6,087.
ekam ekena bāṇena tribhis trīn daśabhir daśa lakṣmaṇasya praciccheda darśayan pāṇilāghavam R_6,087.
sa rāghavaṃ samāsādya krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ vyasṛjac charavarṣāni rāvaṇo rakṣaseṣvaraḥ R_6,087.
tāñ śaraughāṃs tato bhallais tīkṣṇaiś ciccheda rāghavaḥ dīpyamānān mahāvegān kruddhān āśīviṣopamān R_6,087.
ceratuś ca ciraṃ citraṃ maṇḍalaṃ savyadakṣiṇam bāṇavegāt samutkṣiptāv anyonyam aparājitau R_6,087.
tayor bhūtāni vitresur yugapat saṃprayudhyatoḥ raudrayoḥ sāyakamucor yamāntakanikāśayoḥ R_6,087.
śarāndhakāraṃ ākāśaṃ cakratuḥ prathamaṃ tadā gate 'staṃ tapane cāpi mahāmeghāv ivotthitau R_6,087.
tayor abhūt mahāyuddham anyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇoḥ anāsādyam acintyaṃ ca vṛtravāsavayor iva R_6,087.
atha mantrān api japan raudram astram udīrayan śarān bhūyaḥ samādāya rāmaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ R_6,087.
mumoca ca mahātejāś cāpam āyamya vīryavān tāñ śarān rākṣasendrāya cikṣepācchinnasāyakaḥ R_6,087.
siṃhavyāghramukhāṃś cāpi kaṅkakokamukhān api gṛdhraśyenamukhāṃś cāpi sṛgālavadanāṃs tathā R_6,087.
īhāmṛgamukhāṃś cāpi vyāditāsyān bhayāvahān pañcāsyāṃl lelihānāṃś ca sasarja niśitāñ śarān R_6,087.
śarān kharamukhāṃś cānyān varāhamukhasaṃśriitān śvānakukkuṭavaktrāṃś ca makarāśīviṣānanān R_6,087.
agnidīptamukhān bāṇāṃs tatra sūryamukhān api candrārdhacandravaktrāṃś ca dhūmaketumukhān api grahanakṣatravarṇāṃś ca maholkāmukhasaṃsthitān R_6,087.
vidyujjihvopamāṃś cāpi sasarja vividhāñ śarān te rāvaṇaśarā ghorā rāghavāstrasamāhatāḥ R_6,087.
vilayaṃ jagmur ākāśe jaghnuś caiva sahasraśaḥ tad astraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā R_6,087.
tatas tad astraṃ vinihatya rāghavaḥ prasahya tad rāvaṇabāhuniḥsṛtam mudānvito daśarathir mahatmā vinedur uccair muditā kapīśvarāḥ R_6,087.
mudgarāḥ kūṭapāśāś ca dīptāś cāśanayas tathā niṣpetur vividhās tīkṣṇā vātā iva yugakṣaye R_6,088.
tataś cakrāṇi niṣpetur bhāsvarāṇi mahānti ca kārmukād bhīmavegasya daśagrīvasya dhīmataḥ R_6,088.
tair āsīd gaganaṃ dīptaṃ saṃpatadbhir samantataḥ patadbhiś ca diśo dīptaiś candrasūryair grahair iva R_6,088.
hatāśvāt tu tadā vegād avaplutya mahārathāt krodham āhārayat tīvraṃ bhrātaraṃ prati rāvaṇaḥ R_6,088.
aprāptām eva tāṃ bāṇais tribhiś ciccheda lakṣmaṇaḥ athodatiṣṭhat saṃnādo vānarāṇāṃ mahāraṇe R_6,088.
etasminn antare vīro lakṣmaṇas taṃ vibhīṣaṇam prāṇasaṃśayam āpannaṃ tūrṇam abhyavapadyata R_6,088.
mokṣitas te balaślāghin yasmād evaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ vimucya rākṣasaṃ śaktis tvayīyaṃ vinipātyate R_6,088.
ity evam uktvā tāṃ śaktim aṣṭaghaṇṭāṃ mahāsvanām mayena māyāvihitām amoghāṃ śatrughātinīm R_6,088.
arditāś caiva bāṇaughais te pravekeṇa rakṣasām saumitreḥ sā vinirbhidya praviṣṭā dharaṇītalam R_6,088.
pāpātmāyaṃ daśagrīvo vadhyatāṃ pāpaniścayaḥ kāṅkṣitaṃ catakasyeva gharmānte meghadarśanam R_6,088.
asmin muhūrte na cirāt satyaṃ pratiśṛṇomi vaḥ arāvaṇam arāmaṃ vā jagad drakṣyatha vānarāḥ R_6,088.
so 'yam adya raṇe pāpaś cakṣurviṣayam āgataḥ cakṣurviṣayam āgatya nāyaṃ jīvitum arhati R_6,088.
samāgamya sadā loke yathāyuddhaṃ pravartitam evam uktvā śitair bāṇais taptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ ājaghāna raṇe rāmo daśagrīvaṃ samāhitaḥ R_6,088.
tathā praviddhair nārācair musalaiś cāpi rāvaṇaḥ abhyavarṣat tadā rāmaṃ dhārābhir iva toyadaḥ R_6,088.
vichinnāś ca vikīrṇāś ca rāmarāvaṇayoḥ śarāḥ antarikṣāt pradīptāgrā nipetur dharaṇītale R_6,088.
tayor jyātalanirghoṣo rāmarāvaṇayor mahān trāsanaḥ sarvabūtānāṃ sa babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ R_6,088.
sa dattvā tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ visṛjann eva bāṇaughān suṣeṇaṃ vākyam abravīt R_6,089.
yathaiva māṃ vanaṃ yāntam anuyāti mahādyutiḥ | aham apy upayāsyāmi tathaivainaṃ yamakṣayam ||
yena me dhārmiko bhrātā nihataś cāgrataḥ sthitaḥ hā bhrātar manujaśreṣṭha śūrāṇām pravara prabho ||
viṣaṇṇasya mahābāho samāśvāsayitā mama rāmam evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ tu śokavyākulitendriyam ||
āśvāsayann uvācedaṃ suṣeṇaḥ paramaṃ vacaḥ tyajemāṃ naraśārdūla buddhiṃ vaiklavyakāriṇīm ||
śokasaṃjananīṃ cintāṃ tulyāṃ bāṇaiś camūmukhe | naiva pañcatvamāpanno lakṣmaṇo lakṣmivardhanaḥ ||
socchvāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ vīra kampamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | evam uktvā mahāprajñaḥ suṣeṇo rāghavaṃ vacaḥ ||
samīpastham uvācedaṃ hanūmantaṃ mahākapim | saumya śīghram ito gatvā parvataṃ hi mahodayam ||
pūrvaṃ hi kathito yo ‘sau vīra jāmbavatā tava | dakṣiṇe śikhare jātām mahauṣadhim ihānaya ||
viśalyakaraṇīṃ nāmnā sāvarṇyakaraṇīn tathā | saṃjīvakaraṇīṃ vīra saṃdhānīṃ ca mahauṣadhīm ||
saṃjīvanārthaṃ vīrasya lakṣmaṇasya tvam ānaya | ity evam ukto hanumān gatvā cauṣadiparvatam | cintām abhyagamac chrīmān ajānaṃs tā mahauṣadhīḥ ||
plullanānātarugaṇaṃ samutpāṭya mahābalaḥ | gṛhītvā hariśārdūlo hastābhyāṃ samatolayat
vismitās tu babhūvus te sarve vānarapuṃgavāḥ | dṛṣṭvā tu hanūmatkarma surair api suduṣkaram ||
samutthitaṃ te harayo bhūtalāt prekṣya lakṣmaṇam sādhu sādhv iti suprītā lakṣmaṇaṃ pratyapūjayan R_6,089.
ehy ehīty abravīd rāmo lakṣmaṇaṃ paravīrahā sasvaje gāḍham āliṅgya bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ R_6,089.
nairāśyam upagantuṃ ca nālaṃ te matkṛte 'nagha vadhena rāvaṇasyādya pratijñām anupālaya R_6,089.
na jīvan yāsyate śatrus tava bāṇavaśaṃ gataḥ nardatas tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrasya siṃhasyeva mahāgajaḥ R_6,089.
taruṇādityasaṅkāśo vaidūryamayakūbaraḥ | sadaśvaiḥ kāñcanāpīḍair yuktaḥ śvetaprakīrṇakaiḥ
haribhiḥ sūryasaṅkāśair hemajālavibhūṣitaiḥ | rukmaveṇudhvajaḥ śrīmān devarājaratho varaḥ
devarājena saṃdiṣṭo ratham āruhya mātaliḥ | abhyavartata kākutstham avatīrya triviṣṭapāt
idam aindraṃ mahac cāpaṃ kavacaṃ cāgnisaṃnibham | śarāś cādityasaṅkāśāḥ śaktiśca vimalā śivā
tair vāsukisamasparśair dīptabhogair mahāviṣaiḥ diśaś ca saṃtatāḥ sarvā vidiśaś ca samāvṛtāḥ R_6,090.
aindrān api jaghānāśvāñ śarajālena rāvaṇaḥ viṣedur devagandharvacāraṇā dānavaiḥ saha R_6,090.
rāmam ārtaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ vyathitā vānarendrāś ca babhūvuḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ R_6,090.
samākramya budhas tasthau prajānām ahitāvahaḥ sadhūmaparivṛttormiḥ prajvalann iva sāgaraḥ R_6,090.
utpapāta tadā kruddhaḥ spṛśann iva divākaram śastravarṇaḥ suparuṣo mandaraśmir divākaraḥ R_6,090.
āhatyāṅgārakas tasthau viśākham api cāmbare daśāsyo viṃśatibhujaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ R_6,090.
nāśaknod abhisaṃdhātuṃ sāyakān raṇamūrdhani sa kṛtvā bhrukuṭīṃ kruddhaḥ kiṃ cit saṃraktalocanaḥ R_6,090.
vimānasthās tadā devā gandharvāś ca mahoragāḥ ṛṣidānavadaityāś ca garutmantaś ca khecarāḥ R_6,091.
dadṛśus te tadā yuddhaṃ lokasaṃvartasaṃsthitam nānāpraharaṇair bhīmaiḥ śūrayoḥ saṃprayudhyatoḥ R_6,091.
etasminn antare krodhād rāghavasya сa rāvaṇaḥ prahartukāmo duṣṭātmā spṛśan praharaṇaṃ mahat R_6,091.
vajrasāraṃ mahānādaṃ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇam śailaśṛṅganibhaiḥ kūṭaiś cittadṛṣṭibhayāvaham R_6,091.
sadhūmam iva tīkṣṇāgraṃ yugāntāgnicayopamam atiraudram anāsādyaṃ kālenāpi durāsadam R_6,091.
trāsanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dāraṇaṃ bhedanaṃ tathā pradīpta iva roṣeṇa śūlaṃ jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ R_6,091.
tān dṛṣṭvā bhasmasād bhūtāñ śūlasaṃsparśacūrṇitān sāyakān antarikṣasthān rāghavaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥR_6,091.
nirbibheda tato bāṇair hayān asya mahājavān rāmas kṣiptair mahāvegair bāṇavadbhir ajihmagaiḥ R_6,091.
sa śarair bhinnasarvāṅgo gātraprasrutaśoṇitaḥ rākṣasendrasamūhasthaḥ phullāśoka ivābabhau R_6,091.
sa dīptanayano ‘marṣāc cāpam udyamya vīryavān abhyardayat susaṃkruddho rāghavaṃ paramāhave R_6,092.
bāṇadhārāsahasrais tu sa toyada ivāmbarāt rāghavaṃ rāvaṇo bāṇais taṭākam iva pūrayan R_6,092.
bhinnamaryāda nirlajja cāritreṣv anavasthita darpān mṛtyum upādāya śūro 'ham iti manyase R_6,092.
prādurbabhūvur astrāṇi sarvāṇi viditātmanaḥ praharṣāc ca mahātejāḥ śīghrahastataro 'bhavat R_6,092.
kṣiptāś cāśu śarās tena śastrāṇi vividhāni ca maraṇārthāya vartante mṛtyukālo 'bhyavartata R_6,092.
hīnavīryam ivāśaktaṃ pauruṣeṇa vivarjitam bhīruṃ laghum ivāsattvaṃ vihīnam iva tejasā R_6,093.
vimuktam iva māyābhir astrair iva bahiṣkṛtam mām avajñāya durbuddhe svayā buddhyā viceṣṭase R_6,093.
yat tvaṃ katham idaṃ mohān na codvahasi durmate satyo 'yaṃ pratitarko me pareṇa tvam upaskṛtaḥ R_6,093.
deśakālau ca vijñeyau lakṣaṇānīṅgitāni ca dainyaṃ harṣaś ca khedaś ca rathinaś ca mahābalam R_6,093.
ājñāpaya yathātattvaṃ vakṣyasy ariniṣūdana tat kariṣyāmy ahaṃ vīra gatānṛṇyena cetasā R_6,093.
saṃtuṣṭas tena vākyena rāvaṇas tasya sāratheḥ praśasyainaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yuddhalubdho 'bravīd idam R_6,093.
evam uktvā rathasthasya rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ dadau tasya śubhaṃ hy ekaṃ hastābharaṇam uttamam śrutvā rāvaṇavākyāni sārathiḥ saṃnyavartata R_6,093.
daivataiś ca samāgamya draṣṭum abhyāgato raṇam | upagamyābravīd rāmam agastyo bhagavāṃs tadā
sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | cintāśokapraśamanam āyurvardhanam uttamam
haridaśvaḥ sahasrārciḥ saptasaptir marīcimān | timironmathanaḥ śambhus tvaṣṭā mārtaṇḍako ‘ṃśumān
vyomanāthas tamobhedī ṛgyajuḥsāmapāragaḥ | ghanavṛṣṭir apāṃ mitro vindhyavīthīplavaṃgamaḥ
rāvaṇaṃ prekṣya hṛṣṭātmā jayārthaṃ samupāgamat | sarvayatnena mahatā vṛtas tasya vadhe ‘bhavat
sārathiḥ sa ratham hṛṣṭaḥ parasainyapradharṣaṇam | gandharvanagarākāraṃ samucchritapātākinam
yuktaṃ paramasaṃpannair vāibhir hemamālibhiḥ | yuddhopakaraṇaiḥ pūrṇaṃ patākādhvajamālinam
grasantam iva cākāśaṃ nādayantaṃ vasuṃdharām | praṇāśaṃ parasainyānāṃ svasainyasya praharṣaṇam
rāvaṇasya rathaṃ kṣipraṃ codayāmāsa sārathiḥ | tam āpatantaṃ sahasā svanavantaṃ mahādhvajam
dīpyamānam ivākāśe vimānaṃ sūryavarcasaṃ | taḍitpatākāgahanaṃ darśitendrāyudhaprabham
śaradhārā vimuñcantaṃ dhārāsāram ivāmbudam | taṃ dṛṣṭvā meghasaṅkāśam āpatantaṃ rathaṃ ripoḥ
girer vajrābhimṛṣṭasya dīryataḥ sadṛśasvanam | vispārayan vai vegena bālacandrānataṃ dhanuḥ
uvāca mātaliṃ rāmaḥ sahasrākṣasya sārathim | mātale paśya saṃrabdham āpatantaṃ rathaṃ ripoḥ
tad apramādam ātiṣṭha pratyudgaccha rathaṃ ripoḥ| vidhvaṃsayitum icchāmi vāyur megham ivotthitam
śarāṃś ca sumahāvegān sūryaraśmisamaprabhān | tadupoḍhaṃ mahad yuddham anyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇoḥ
parasparābhimukhayor dṛptayor iva siṃhayoḥ
samīyur dvairathaṃ draṣṭuṃ rāvaṇakṣayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
samutpetur athotpātā dāruṇā lomaharṣaṇāḥ
gṛdhrair anugatāś cāsya vamantyo jvalanaṃ mukhaiḥ | praṇedur mukham īkṣantyaḥ saṃrabdham aśivaṃ śivāḥ
nānāpraharaṇair vyagrair bhujair vismitabuddhayaḥ | tasthuḥ prekṣya ca sarvaṃ te nābhijagmuḥ parasparam
te śarās tam anāsādya purandararathadhvajam | rathaśaktiṃ parāmṛśya nipetur dharaṇītale
sa nikṛtto ‘patad bhūmau rāvaṇasyondanadhvajaḥ | dhvajasyonmathanaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaḥ sa mahābalaḥ
saṃpradīpto bhavat krodhād amarśāt pradahann iva | sa roṣavaśamāpannaḥ śaravarṣaṃ vavarṣa ha
rāmasya turagān dīptaiḥ śarair vivyādha rāvaṇaḥ | te divyā harayas tatra nāskhalann āpi babhramuḥ
babhūvuḥ svasthahṛdayāḥ padmanālair ivāhatāḥ | teṣām asambhramaṃ dṛṣṭvā vājināṃ rāvaṇas tadā
giriśṛṅgāṇi vṛkṣāṃśca tathā śūlaparaśvadhān | māyāvihitam etat tu śastravarṣam apātayat || sahasraśas tato bāṇān abhrāntahṛdayodyamaḥ
prahasanniva kākutsthaḥ saṃdadhe niśitān śarān | sa mumoca tato bāṇān śataśo ‘tha sahasraśaḥ
śarabaddham ivābhāti dvitīyaṃ bhāsvad ambaram | nānimitto ‘bhavad bāṇo nānirbhettā na niṣphalaḥ
anyonyam abhisaṃhatya nipetur dharaṇītale | tathā visṛjator bāṇān rāmarāvaṇayor mṛdhe
prāyudhyetām avicchinnam asyantau savyadakṣiṇam | cakratuś ca śarair ghorair nirucchvāsam ivāmbaram
gativegaṃ samāpannau prativeganivartane | kṣipatoḥ śarajālāni tayos tau syandanottamau
parasparasyābhimukhau punar eva ca tasthatuḥ | dhuraṃ dhureṇa rathayor vaktraṃ vaktreṇa vājinām
caturbhiścaturo dīptān hayān pratyapasarpayat | sa krodhavaśamāpanno hayānām apasarpaṇe
sārathiṃ vajrahastasya samādiśya daśānanaḥ | mātales tu mahāvegāḥ sarīre patitāḥ śarāḥ
na sūkṣmamapi saṃmohaṃ vyathāṃ vā pradadur yudhi | tayā dharṣaṇayā kruddho mātaler na tathātmanaḥ
mumoca rāghavo vīraḥ sāyakān syandane ripoḥ | rāvaṇo ‘pi tataḥ kruddho rathastho rākṣaseśvaraḥ
gadāmusalavarṣeṇa rāmaṃ pratyardayad raṇe | tatprayuktaṃ punaryuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam
evaṃ japanto ‘paśyaṃs te devāḥ sarṣigaṇās tadā | rāmarāvaṇayor yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam
gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṃghā dṛṣṭvā yuddham anūpamam | sāgaraṃ cāmbaraprakhyam ambaraṃ sāgaropamam
rāmarāvaṇayor yuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayor iva | evaṃ bruvanto dadṛśus tad yuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇam
rāvaṇasya śiro ‘cchindac chrīmaj jvalitakuṇḍalam | tac chiraḥ patitaṃ bhūmau dṛṣṭaṃ lokais tribhis tadā
mārgaṇair bahubhir yuktaś cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ | mārīco nihato yais tu kharo yaistu sadūṣaṇaḥ
krauñcāvaṭe virādhas tu kabandho daṇḍakāvane | yaiḥ sālā girayo bhagnā vālī ca kṣubhito ‘mbudhiḥ
daśarathasutarākṣasendrayos tayor | jayam anavekṣya raṇe sa rāghavasya | suravararathasārathir mahātmā | raṇaratarāmam uvāca vākyam āśu
yaṃ tasmai prathamaṃ prādād agastyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ | brahmadattaṃ mahābāṇam amoghaṃ yudhi vīryavān
nandanaṃ vānarendrāṇāṃ rakṣasām avasādanam | vājitaṃ vividhair vājaiś cārucitrair garutmataḥ
tam uttameṣum lokānām ikṣvākubhayanāśanam | dviṣatāṃ kīrtiharaṇam praharṣakaram ātmanaḥ
arditā vānarair bhraṣṭā laṅkām abhyapatan bhayāt | hatāśrayatvāt karuṇair bāṣpaprasravaṇair mukhaiḥ
siṃharkṣalāṅgūlakakudviṣāṇaḥ | parābhijidgandhanagandhavāhaḥ | rakṣovṛṣaś cāpalakarṇacakṣuḥ | kṣitīśvaravyāgrahato ‘vasannaḥ
tam uktavākyaṃ vikrāntaṃ rājaputraṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ uvāca śokasaṃtapto bhrātur hitam anantaram
yo 'yaṃ vimardeṣv avibhagnapūrvaḥ | suraiḥ samastair api vāsavena | bhavantam āsādya raṇe vibhagno | velām ivāsādya yathā samudraḥ
āryaputreti vādinyo hā nātheti ca sarvaśaḥ | paripetuḥ kabandhāṅkāṃ mahīṃ śoṇitakardamām
bahumānāt pariṣvajva kācid enaṃ ruroda ha | caraṇau kācid ālambya kācit kaṇṭhe ‘valambya ca
evam ārtāḥ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṃ nihataṃ bhuvi | cukruśur bahudhā śokād bhūyas tāḥ paryadevayan
gandharvāṇām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām | bhayaṃ yena raṇe dattaṃ so ‘yaṃ śete raṇe hataḥ
yo na śakyaḥ surair hantuṃ na yakṣair nāsuras tathā | so ‘yaṃ kaścid ivāsattvo mṛtyuṃ martyena lambhitaḥ
bruvāṇo ‘pi hitaṃ vākyam iṣṭo bhrātā vibhīṣaṇaḥ | dṛṣṭaṃ paruṣito mohāt tvayātmavadhakāṅkṣiṇā
mahābalaṃ mahāvīryaṃ devaśatruṃ mahaujasam | vyaktam eṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātanaḥ
anādimadhyanidhano mahataḥ paramo mahān | tamasaḥ paramo dhātā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīr ajayaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ | mānuṣaṃ rūpam āsthāya viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ
sarvaiḥ parivṛto devair vānaratvam upāgataiḥ | sarvalokeśvaraḥ śrīmāṃl lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
smaradbhir iva tadvairam indriyair eva nirjitaḥ | yadaiva hi janasthāne rākṣasair bahubhir vṛtaḥ
praviṣṭo hanumān vīryāt tadaiva vyathitā vayam | kriyatām avirodhaś ca rāghaveṇeti yan mayā
ucyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāsi tasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭir āgatā | akasmāc cābhikāmo ‘si sītāṃ rākṣasapuṃgava
sītāṃ dharṣayatā mānyāṃ tvayā hy asadṛśaṃ kṛtam | vasudhāyā hi vasudhāṃ śriyaḥ śrīṃ bhartṛvatsalām
sītāṃ sarvānavadyāṅgīm araṇye vijane śubhām | ānayitvā tu tāṃ dīnāṃ chadmanātmasvadūṣaṇam
śubhakṛc chubham āpnoti pāpakṛt pāpam aśnute | vibhīṣaṇaḥ sukhaṃ prāptas tvaṃ prāptaḥ pāpam īdṛśam
santy anyāḥ pramadās tubhyaṃ rūpeṇābhyadhikās tataḥ | anaṅgavaśam āpannas tvaṃ tu mohān na budhyase
sarvadā sarvabhūtānāṃ nāsti mṛtyur alakṣaṇaḥ | tava tadvad ayaṃ mṛtyur maithilīkṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
devodyāneṣu sarveṣu vihṛtya sahitā tvayā | vimānenānurūpeṇa yā yāmy atulayā śriyā
paśyantī vividhān deśāṃs tāṃs tāṃś citrasragambarā | bhraṃśitā kāmabhogebhyaḥ sāsmi vīra vadhāt tava
saivānyevāsmi saṃvṛttā dhig rāñjāṃ cañcalām śriyam hā rājan sukumāraṃ te subhru sutvaksamunnasam
kāntiśrīdyutibhis tulyam indupadmadivākaraiḥ | kirīṭakūṭojjvalitaṃ tāmrāsyaṃ dīptakuṇḍalam
madavyākulalolākṣaṃ bhūtvā yat pānabhūmiṣu | vividhasragdharaṃ cāru valgusmitakathaṃ śubham
yā mayāsīn na saṃbuddhā kadācid api mandayā | pitā dānavarājo me bhartā me rākṣaseśvaraḥ
putro me śakranirjetā ity ahaṃ garvitā bhṛśam | dṛptārimardanāḥ śūrāḥ prakhyātabalapauruṣāḥ
akutaścid bhayā nāthā mamety āsīn matir dṛḍhā | teṣām evaṃprabhāvāṇāṃ yuṣmākaṃ rākṣasarṣabhāḥ
kathaṃ bhayam asaṃbuddhaṃ mānuṣād idam āgatam | snigdendranīlanīlaṃ tu prāṃśuśailopamaṃ mahat
keyūrāṅgadavaidūryamuktāhārasragujjvalam | kāntaṃ vihāreṣv adhikaṃ dīptaṃ saṃgrāmabhūmiṣu
bhāty ābharaṇabhābhir yad vidyudbhir iva toyadaḥ | tadevādya śarīraṃ te tīkṣṇair naikaśaraiś citam
punar durlabhasaṃsparśaṃ pariṣvaktuṃ na śakyate | śvāvidhaḥ śalalair yuktaṃ lagnair bāṇair nirantaram
svarpitair marmasu bhṛśaṃ saṃchinnasnāyubandhanam | kṣitau nipatitaṃ rājan śyāmaṃ vai rudhiracchavi
tvaṃ mṛtyor api mṛtyuḥ syāḥ kathaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ | trailokyavasubhoktāraṃ trailokyodvegadaṃ mahat
dharmavyavasthābhettāraṃ māyāsraṣṭāram āhave | devāsuranṛkanyānām āhartāraṃ tatas tataḥ
sthirāsmi yā deham imaṃ dhārayāmi hatapriyā | śayaneṣu mahārheṣu śayitvā rākṣaseśvara
iha kasmāt prāsupto ‘si dharaṇyāṃ reṇuguṇṭhitaḥ | yadā te tanayaḥ śasto lakṣmaṇenendrajid yudhi
tadā tv abhihatā tīvram adya tv asmi nipātitā | sāhaṃ bandhujanair hīnā hīnā nāthena ca tvayā
vihīnā kāmabhogaiś ca śociṣye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | prapanno dīrgham adhvānaṃ rājann adya sudurgamam
nirgatāṃ nagaradvārāt padbhyām evāgatāṃ prabho | paśyeṣṭadāra dārāṃs te bhraṣṭalajjāvaguṇṭhanān
bahir niṣpatitān sarvān kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā na kupyasi | ayam krīḍāsahāyas te ‘nātho lālapyate janaḥ
na cainam āśvāsayasi kiṃ vā na bahumanyase | yās tvayā vidhavā rājan kṛtā naikāḥ kulastriyaḥ
nārīcauryam idaṃ kṣudraṃ kṛtaṃ śauṇḍīryamāninā | apanīyāśramād rāmaṃ yan mṛgacchadmanā tvayā
ānītā rāmapatnī sā apanīyā ca lakṣmaṇam | kātaryaṃ na ca te yuddhe kadācit saṃsmarāmy aham
tat tu bhāgyaviparyāsān nūnaṃ te pakvalakṣaṇam | atītānāgatārthajño vartamānavicakṣaṇaḥ
maithilīm āhṛtām dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā niḥśvasya cāyatam | satyavāk sa mahābāho devaro me yad abravīt
nirvṛttas tvatkṛte ‘narthaḥ so ‘yaṃ mūlaharo mahān | tvayā kṛtam idaṃ sarvam anāthaṃ rakṣasāṃ kulam
adya vai nirbhayā laṅkāṃ praviṣṭāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ | yena sūdayase śatrūn samare sūryavarcasā
parigho vyavakīrṇas te bāṇaiś chinnaḥ sahasradhā | priyām ivopasaṃgṛhya kim śeṣe raṇamedinīm
apriyāmiva kasmācca māṃ necchasy abhibhāṣitum | dhig astu hṛdayaṃ yasyā mamedaṃ na sahasradhā
saṃdhyānurakte jalade dīptā vidyudivojjvalā | tathāgatāṃ samutthāpya sapatnyas tāṃ bhṛśāturāḥ
snāpayantī tadāsreṇa stanau vaktraṃ sunirmalam | etasminnantare rāmo vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha
vimṛśya buddhyā praśritaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam | tyaktadharmavrataṃ krūraṃ nṛśaṃsam anṛtaṃ tathā
nāham arhāmi saṃskartuṃ paradārābhimarśanam | bhrātṛrūpo hi me śatrur eṣa sarvāhite rataḥ
avaśyaṃ tu kṣamaṃ vācyo mayā tvaṃ rākṣaseśvara | adharmānṛtasaṃyuktaḥ kāmam eṣa niśācaraḥ
kriyatām asya saṃskāro mamāpy eṣa yathā tava | tvatsakāśān mahābāho saṃskāraṃ vidhipūrvakam
rāvanasyāgnihotraṃ tu niryāpayati satvaram | śakaṭān dārurūpāṇi agnīn vai yājakāṃs tathā
maṇimuktāpravālāni niryāpayati rākṣasaḥ | ājagāma muhūrtena rākṣasaiḥ parivāritaḥ
tato mālyavatā sārdhaṃ kriyām eva cakāra saḥ | sauvarṇīṃ śibikāṃ divyām āropya kṣaumavāsasam
rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhiśam aśrupūrṇamukhā dvijāḥ | tūryaghoṣaiś ca vividhais tu vadbhiś cābhinanditam
patākābhiś ca citrābhiḥ sumanobhiś ca citritām | utkṣipya śibikāṃ tāṃ tu vibhīṣaṇapurogamāḥ
pṛṣṭhato ‘nuyayus tāni plavamānāni sarvataḥ | rāvaṇam prayate deśe sthāpya te bhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ
citāṃ candanakāṣṭhaiś ca padmakośīracandanaiḥ | brāhmyā saṃvartayāmāsū rāṅkavāstaraṇāvṛtām
paristaraṇīkāṃ rājño ghṛtāktāṃ samaveśayan | gandhair mālyair alaṃkṛtya rāvaṇaṃ dīnāmānasāḥ
vibhīṣaṇasahāyās te vastraiś ca vividhair api | lājair avakiranti sma bāṣpapūrṇamukhās tathā
udakena ca saṃmiśrān pradāya vidhipūrvakam | tāḥ striyo ‘nunayāmāsa sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ
gamyatām iti tāḥ sarvā viviśur nagaraṃ tataḥ | praviṣṭāsu purīṃ strīṣu rākṣasendro vibhīṣaṇaḥ | rāmapārśvam upāgamya samātiṣṭhad vinītavat
anurāgaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca saumitrer lakṣmaṇasya ca | pativratātvam sītāyā hanūmati parākramam
kathayanto mahābhāgā jagmur hṛṣṭa yathāgatam | rāghavas tu rathaṃ divyam indradattaṃ śikhiprabham
anujñāya mahābāhur mātaliṃ pratyapūjayat | rāghaveṇābhyanujñāto mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ
divyaṃ taṃ ratham āsthāya divam evotpapāta ha | tasmiṃs tu divam āruḍhe sarathe rathināṃ varaḥ
saumitriṃ mitrasaṃpannaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam | vibhīṣaṇam imaṃ saumya laṅkāyām abhiṣecaya
laṅkāyāṃ saumya paśyeyam abhiṣiktaṃ vibhīṣaṇam | evam uktas tu saumitrī rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
vyādideśa mahāsattvaḥ samudrasalilaṃ tadā | atiśīghram tato gatvā vānarās te manojavāḥ
āgatās tu jalaṃ gṛhya samudrād vānarottamāḥ | tatas tv ekaṃ ghaṭaṃ gṛhya saṃsthāpya paramāsane
vidhinā mantradṛṣṭena suhṛdgaṇasamāvṛtaḥ | abhyaṣiñcaṃs tadā sarve rākṣasā vānarās tathā
dṛṣṭvābhiṣiktaṃ laṅkāyāṃ rākṣasendraṃ vibhīṣaṇam | rāghavaḥ paramāṃ prītiṃ jagāma sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
[sa tadrājyaṃ mahatprāpya rāmadattaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ |] sāntyayitvā prakṛtayas tato rāmam upāgamat | dadhyakṣatān modakāṃśca lājāḥ sumanasas tathā
priyam etad ihākhyāhi vaidehyas tvaṃ harīśvara | pratigṛhya tu saṃdeśam upāvartitum arhasi
praviśya ca purīṃ laṅkām anujñāpya vibhīṣaṇam | tatas tenābhyanujñāto hanūmān vṛkṣavāṭikām
saṃpraviśya yathānyāyam sītāyā vidito hariḥ | dadarśa mṛjayā hīnāṃ sātaṅkām rohiṇīm iva
vṛkṣamūle nirānandāṃ rākṣasībhiḥ parīvṛtām | nibhṛtaḥ praṇataḥ prahvaḥ so ‘bhigamyābhivādya ca
labdho ‘yaṃ vijayaḥ sīte svasthā bhava gatajvarā | rāvaṇaś ca hataḥ śatrur laṅkā caiva vaśīkṛtā
priyam etad upaśrutya bhartur vijayasaṃśrayam | praharṣavaśam āpannā nirvākyāsmi kṣaṇāntaram
na ca paśyāmi tat sadṛśaṃ pṛthivyām tava kiṃcana | sadṛśaṃ yat priyākhyāne tava dattvā bhavet sukham
bhartuḥ priyahite yukte bhartur vijayakāṅkṣiṇi | snigdham evaṃvidhaṃ vākyaṃ tvam evārhasy anindite
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ sthairyaṃ vinītatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | ete cānye ca bahavo guṇās tvyayyeva śobhanāḥ
iha śrutā mayā devi rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ | asakṛt paruṣair vākyair vadantyo rāvaṇājñayā
nipātya hantum icchāmi tava vipriyakāriṇīḥ | vikṛtā vikṛtākārāḥ krūrāḥ krūrakacekṣaṇāḥ| icchāmi vividhair ghātair hantum etāḥ sudāruṇāḥ
rākṣasyo dāruṇakathā varam etaṃ prayaccha me | muṣṭibhiḥ pārṣṇighātaiś ca viśālaiś caiva bāhubhiḥ
nipātya hantum icchāmi tava vipriyakāriṇīḥ | evaṃ prahārair bahubhir saṃprahārya yaśasvini
ghātaye tīvrarūpābhir yābhis tvaṃ tarjitā purā | ity uktā sā hanumatā kṛpaṇā dīnavatsalā
vidheyānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ kaḥ kupyed vānarottama | bhāgyavaiṣamyadoṣeṇa purastād duśkṛtena ca
mayaitet prāpyate sarvaṃ svakṛtaṃ hy upabhujyate | maiva vada mahābāho daivī hy eṣā parā gatiḥ
ājñaptā rākṣaseneha rākṣasyas tarjayanti mām | hate tasmin na kurvanti tarjanaṃ mārutātmaja
lokahiṃsāvihārāṇāṃ krūrāṇāṃ pāpakarmaṇām | kurvatām api pāpāni naiva kāryam aśobhanam
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ | harṣayan maithilīṃ vākyam uvācedaṃ mahādyutiḥ
pūrṇacandramukhaṃ rāmaṃ drakṣyasyadya salakṣmaṇam | sthitamitraṃ hatāmitraṃ śacīvendraṃ sureśvaram
pūrvakāt pratyayāc cāham ukto viśvastayā tayā | draṣṭum icchāmi bhartāram iti paryākulekṣaṇā
evam ukto hanumatā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | agacchat sahasā dhyānam īṣad bāṣpapariplutaḥ
sa dīrgham abhiniḥśvasya jagatīm avalokayan | uvāca meghasaṃkāśaṃ vibhīṣaṇam upasthitam
āropya śibikāṃ sītāṃ rākṣasair vahanocitaiḥ | rakṣasair bahubhir guptām ājahāra vibhīṣaṇaḥ
so ‘bhigamya mahātmānaṃ jñātvāpi dhyānam āsthitam | praṇataś ca prahṛṣṭaś ca prāptāṃ sītāṃ nyavedayat
tām āgatām upaśrutya rakṣogṛhaciroṣitām | roṣaṃ harṣaṃ ca dainyaṃ ca rāghavaḥ prāpa śatruhā
tato yānagatāṃ sītāṃ savimarśaṃ vicārayan | vibhīṣaṇam idaṃ vākyam ahṛṣṭo rāghavo ‘bravīt
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rāghavasya vibhīṣaṇaḥ | tūrṇam utsāraṇaṃ tatra yatnaṃ kārayāmāsa dharmavit
kañcukoṣṇīṣiṇas tatra vetrajharjharapāṇayaḥ | utsārayantas tān yodhān samantāt paricakramuḥ
teṣām utsāryamāṇānāṃ niḥsvanaḥ sumahān abhūt | vāyunoddhuyamānasya sāgarasyeva niḥsvanaḥ
utsāryamāṇān dṛṣṭvātha jagatyāṃ jātasambhramān | dākṣiṇyāt tadamarṣāc ca vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
saṃrabdhaś cābravīd rāmaś cakṣuṣā pradahann iva | vibhīṣaṇaṃ mahāprājñaṃ sopālambham idaṃ vacaḥ
kim arthaṃ mām anādṛtya kṛśyate ‘yaṃ tvayā janaḥ | nivartayainam udvegaṃ jano ‘yaṃ svajano mama
saiṣā yuddhagatā caiva kṛcchreṇa ca samanvitā | darśane nāsti doṣo ‘syā matsamīpe viśeṣataḥ
gato ‘smy antam amarṣasya dharṣaṇā saṃpramārjitā | avamānaś ca śatruś ca yugapan nihatau mayā
saṃprāptam avamānaṃ yas tejasā na pramārjati | kas tasya pauruṣeṇārtho mahatāpy alpacetasaḥ
rakṣatā tu mayā vṛttam apavādam ca sarvataḥ | prakhyātasyātmavaṃśasya nyaṅgaṃ ca parimārjatā
praviśantīva gātrāṇi svāni sā janakātmajā | vākṣaraiḥ taiḥ saśalyeva bhṛśam aśrūṇy avartayat
tato bāṣpapariklinnaṃ pramārjantī svam ānanam | śanair gadgadayā vācā bhartāram idam abravīt
evaṃ uktas tu vaidehyā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā | amarṣavaśam āpanno rāghavaṃ samudaikṣata
praṇamya devatābhyaś ca brāhmaṇebhyaś ca maithilī | baddhāñjalipuṭā cedam uvācāgnisamīpataḥ
dadṛśus tāṃ mahābhāgāṃ praviśantīṃ hutāśanam | ṛṣayo devagandharvā yajñe pūrṇāhutīm iva
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā yamaś ca pitṛbhiḥ saha | sahasrākṣaś ca deveśo varuṇaś ca jaleśvaraḥ
ete sarve samāgamya vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ | āgamya nagarīṃ laṅkām abhijagmuś ca rāghavam
senānīrgrāmaṇīḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ buddhis tvaṃ kṣamā damaḥ | prabhavaś cāpy ayaś ca tvam upendro madhusūdanaḥ
siddhānām api sādhyānām āśrayaś cāsi pūrvajaḥ | tvaṃ yajñas tvaṃ vaṣaṭkāras tvam oṃkāraḥ parātparaḥ
devā romāṇi gātreṣu brahmaṇā nirmitāḥ prabho | nimeṣas te smṛtā rātrir unmeṣo divasas tathā
saṃskārās tv abhavan vedā naitad asti tvayā vinā | jagat sarvaṃ śarīraṃ te sthairyaṃ te vasudhātalam
agniḥ kopaḥ prasādas te somaḥ śrīvatsalakṣaṇaḥ | tvayā lokās trayaḥ krāntāḥ purā svair vikramais tribhiḥ
vadhārthaṃ rāvaṇasyeha praviṣṭo mānuṣīṃ tanum | tad idaṃ nas tvayā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma amoghas tava saṃstavaḥ | amoghās te bhaviṣyanti bhaktimanto narā bhuvi
tad idaṃ nas tvayā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
nihato rāvaṇo rāma prahṛṣṭo divam ākrama | amoghaṃ deva vīryaṃ te na te moghāḥ parākramāḥ
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma amoghas tava saṃstavaḥ | amoghās te bhaviṣyanti bhaktimanto narā bhuvi
ye tvāṃ devam dhruvaṃ bhaktāḥ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam | prāpnuvanti tathā kāmān iha loke paratra ca
akliṣṭamālyābharaṇāṃ tathārūpām aninditām | dadau rāmāya vaidehīm aṅke kṛtvā vibhāvasuḥ
ananyahṛdayāṃ sītāṃ maccittaparivartinīm | aham apy avagacchāmi maithilīṃ janakātmajām
prāpya rājyam ayodhyāṃ ca nandayitvā suhṛjjanam | ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule vaṃśaṃ sthāpayitvā mahābala
iṣṭvā turagamedhena prāpya cānuttamaṃ yaśaḥ | brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā tridivaṃ gantum arhasi
āropyāṅke mahābāhur varāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ | bāhubhyāṃ sampariṣvajya tato vākyaṃ samādade
ete sendrās trayo lokāḥ siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ | abhivādya mahātmānam arcanti puruṣottamam
matpriyeṣv abhiraktāś ca na mṛtyuṃ gaṇayanti ye | tvatprasādāt sameyus te varam etam ahaṃ vṛṇe
mahān ayaṃ varas tāta yas tvayokto raghuttama | dvir mayā noktapurvaṃ ca tasmād etad bhaviṣyati
babhūvur vānarāḥ sarve kiṃ tv etad iti vismitāḥ | kākutthsaṃ paripūrṇārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve surottamāḥ
maithilīṃ sāntvayasvainām anuraktāṃ yaśasvinīm | bhrātaraṃ bharataṃ paśya tvacchokād vratacāriṇam
alaṃkāravidaś caitā nāryaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇāḥ | upasthitās tvāṃ vidhivat snāpayiṣyanti rāghava
hṛtaṃ nirjitya samgrāme kāmagaṃ divyam uttamam | tvadarthaṃ pālitaṃ cedaṃ tiṣṭhaty atulavikrama
kausalyāṃ ca sumitrām ca kaikeyīṃ ca yaśasvinīm | guham ca suhṛdaṃ caiva paurān janapadaiḥ saha
evamuktastu rāmeṇa rākṣasendro vibhīṣanaḥ | vimānaṃ sūryasamkāśamājuhāva tvarānvitaḥ
tataḥ kāñcanacitrāṅgaṃ vaidūryamaṇivedikam | kūṭāgāraiḥ parikṣiptaṃ  sarvato rajataprabham
pāṇḍurābhih patākābhir dhvajaiśca samalaṃkṛtam | kāñcanaṃ kāñcanair harmyair hemapadmavibhūṣitaiḥ
prakīrṇaṃ kiṅkiṇījālair muktāmaṇigavākṣakam | ghaṇṭājālaiḥ parikṣiptam sarvato madhurasvanam
taṃ meruśikharākāraṃ nirmitam viśvakarmaṇā | bṛhadbirbhūṣitaṃ harmyair muktārajataśobhitaiḥ
talaih sphaṭikacitrāṅgair vaidūryaiś ca varāsanaiḥ | mahārhastaraṇopetair upapannaṃ mahādhanaiḥ
evam uktas tu rāmeṇa vānarāṃs tān vibhīṣaṇaḥ | ratnārthasaṃvibhāgena sarvān evābhyapūjayat
tatas tān pūjitān dṛṣṭvā ratnārthair hariyūthapān | āruroha tadā rāmas tad vimānam anuttamam
dṛṣṭvā tvām abhiṣekārdhaṃ kausalyām abhivādya ca | acirād āgamiṣyāmaḥ svagṛhān nṛpasattama
te sarve vānararkṣaś ca rākṣasāś ca mahābalāḥ | yathā sukham asaṃbādhaṃ divye tasminn upāviśan
akampanaśca nihato balino ‘nye ca rākṣasāḥ | triśirāś cātikāyaś ca devāntakanarāntakau
yuddhonmattaś ca mattaś ca rākṣasapravarāv ubhau | nikumbhaś caiva kumbhaś ca kumbhakarṇātmajau balī
akampanaś ca nihataḥ śoṇitākṣaś ca vīryavān | yūpākṣaś ca prajaṅghaś ca nihatau tu mahāhave
sapatnīnān sahasreṇa sāsreṇa parivāritā | etat tu dṛśyate tīrthaṃ samudrasya varānane
yatra sāgaram uttīrya tāṃ rātrim uṣitā vayam | eṣa setur mayā baddhaḥ sāgare lavaṇārṇave
tava hetor viśālākṣi nalasetuḥ suduṣkaraḥ | paśya sāgaram akṣobhyaṃ vaidehi varuṇālayam
atra pūrvaṃ mahādevaḥ prasādam akarot prabhuḥ | etat tu dṛśyate tīrthaṃ sāgarasya mahātmanaḥ
abravīt praśritaṃ vākyaṃ rāmaṃ praṇayasādhvasā | sugrīvapriyabhāryābhis tārāpramukhāto nṛpa
vimānaṃ prekṣya sugrīvaṃ vākyam etad uvāca ha | brūhi vānaraśārdūla sarvān vānarapuṅgavān
strībhiḥ parivṛtāh sarve hy ayodhyāṃ yāntu sītayā | tathā tvam ebhiḥ sarvābhiḥ strībhiḥ saha mahābala
abhitvarasva sugrīva gacchāmaḥ plavagādhipa | evam uktas tu sugrīvo rāmeṇāmitatejasā
vānarādhipatiḥ śrīmāṃs taiś ca sarvaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ | praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ śīghram tārām udvīkṣya so ‘bravīt
ṛṣyamūkasamīpe tu vaidehīṃ punar abravīt | dṛśyate ‘sau mahān sīte savidyud iva toyadaḥ
ṛśyamūko girivaraḥ kāñcanair dhātubhir vṛtaḥ | atrāhaṃ vānarendreṇa sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ
tvayā vihīno yatrāhaṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ | asyās tīre mayā dṛṣṭā śabarī dharmacāriṇī
atra yojanabāhuś ca kabandho nihato mayā | dṛśyate ‘sau janasthāne sīte śrīmān vanaspatiḥ
[kharaś ca nihataś saṃkhye dūṣaṇaś ca nipātitaḥ triśirāś ca mahāvīryo mayā bāṇair ajihmagaiḥ] etat tad āśramapadam asmakāṃ varavarṇini parṇaśālā tathā citrā dṛśyate śubhadarśane
yatra tvaṃ rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt | eṣā godāvarī ramyā prasannasalilā śubhā
agastyasyāśramaś caiva dṛśyate kadalīvṛtaḥ | dṛśyate caiva vaidehi śarabhaṅgāśramo mahān
upayātaḥ sahasrākṣo yatra śakraḥ puraṃdaraḥ | ete te tāpasā devi dṛśyante tanumadhyame
atriḥ kulapatir yatra sūryavaiśvānaropamaḥ | asmin deśe mahākāyo virādho nihato mayā
